title: Move fast Own deliverables
body:
Generic advice [@Brian](person:6f790c53-9404-4b7e-86de-4498a071899d) gave me that he said applied just to me. He lied
about that, so it actually speaks more about his stressors and how he
engages with his coworkers/friends. I don't trust him.

- Move fast, "hacker" mentality---iterate, deliver value at every step
  (not just when "done"), "earn the right" for more.

- Work as though under time constraints---we need to be moving with
  more urgency, not "get there when we get there."

- Own deliverables---know what's needed and execute without
  follow-ups.

- Stay out of the weeds---focus on high-impact work, fewer
  distractions.

- When given a deadline, deliver---no delays, no "eventually." If I
  ask for a plan, demo, or idea to try, do it---I don't have time to
  check in.

- Own your vision, prioritize effectively, and adapt---hold ideas
  loosely.

- Communicate with me at a strategic level---focus on capabilities and
  value, not just the technical details.

- Communicate your work to share up at an exec level---weekly
  visibility is required. Not my job to define or force your updates.

- If unclear, own getting what you need from me---I can't read minds.
  Communicate strategically to surface alignment gaps.

- When asked to try something (e.g., a doc or experiment), just do
  it---immediately.

- Read shared info, especially when tagged---it's valuable and limited
  to what matters.

- Stay focused, come prepared---no multitasking in key meetings like
  Show & Tell, listen so that we don't have to repeat.

- Less discussion, more execution---fewer long meetings, more
  building.

- Listen first, hold a thought---don't interject too quickly.

- Be okay with uncertainty---focus on what you do know, not what's
  missing.

- Trust leadership decisions---you won't have all the context, and
  neither do I with [@Sam](person:41cdc8cb-0dcc-4dc9-94ce-c0f2c33b41cb). We don't have time for full alignment, but we
  trust each other.

- Reduce negativity, pushing for proof/answers, and challenging things
  outside of area of responsibility.

- Expect old discussions to resurface as priorities shift---don't
  resist it.

- Expect old ideas and work to resurface as if new ideas---it is a
  thing, we don't need to keep calling it out.

- Performance isn't at the principal level yet---more ownership and
  impact are required.

- These conversations are expensive. We can do them once, but cannot
  keep revisiting.

Here are the one-sentence summaries for each category:

- **Be visionary**: Own and communicate your vision effectively at a
  strategic level, ensuring executive visibility without needing
  reminders.

- **Get more done**: Work with urgency, iterate quickly, meet
  deadlines, and execute without requiring constant follow-ups or
  repeated conversations.

- **Do more impactful work**: Focus on high-value contributions, take
  greater ownership, and operate at a higher performance level.

- **Be a better team player**: Prioritize execution over excessive
  discussion, stay engaged in meetings, listen actively, and minimize
  negativity.

- **Manage knowledge better**: Proactively seek clarity, trust
  leadership decisions, adapt to shifting priorities, and engage with
  shared information strategically.

I can't seem to figure this one out. [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) and the family are important to me (though she is exhausting) and Mav is important to me. Potential resolutions:

- help Mav not feel like the enemy
- continue not trusting Jen and keep trying to have relationships without her.
- give up the family

What do you want to make happen in YOUR life, Paul? What does taking charge and leading look like? Showing Jen, and Fiona, and [@Sinead](person:72a05873-c2c7-4de6-b5e2-ae6c2abcf2d3), and [@Miss](person:e49a542a-d5c6-4ea0-ac32-fdc625cf6f79) and [@Shaughn](person:32f526b6-b1f3-4cf7-bbb1-8428b223c505) how to treat you and Mav? What does it look like to show Mav how to treat your family?

How will they know what to you want if you don't tell them?

Mav, I want you to understand that I built my family and I want to keep it. Jen is a major part of it. We chose not to be one another's lovers, but she is still the mother of my children and the sister of my inlaws that mean a lot to me.
Jen, I want you to understand that Mav is my lover and I will always defer to her needs first in our relationship. I want you to understand that I want you to be part of my life, but not at the expense of my relationship with Mav. I want to honor you as the Queen Bee of the family, and that family now includes Mav.
Fiona and Sinead, our family is bigger. Mav will never be the queen bee. But the queen be is no longer my lover.

---

The thing is, I could have been here over a year ago, but instead of choosing this, Jen chose to tell me to fuck off again. Over a year ago, I wanted to bring Mav into the family, and had hoped that Jen would be as "relational-anarchy" as she claimed to be. But instead, she said she didn't want Mav to be at family events and said I wasn't paying her enough attention. I felt paying her attention threatened my relationship with Mav, which I wasn't willing to do... Jen had her chance for 25 years. If she wasn't going to be a good RA partner, then I didn't want her. But it's true, she is the queen-bee with my kids. My kids don't want to do "family" without her. She, in that way, because of her tantrum, isolated me from my kids. Basically my kids are saying "If you don't repair with mom, we don't want to do family with you". My kid's insistence on this is keeping me from seeing them in a "family" context. They don't want "family #2" when they've invested so much in "family #1".

So... I could insist that the kids accept family #2 away from Jen. Get stubborn about it... you'll join me at these events or you don't see me. Insist on the perspective that this is my home, and this is where they are family with me.

Or I could just hang out with them individually... not have a family of my own apart from Mav.

Or I could give Jen another try and integrate Mav into family #1.

The concept of "Home". My place. The place I invite my daughters into. The place I build traditions and create memories. The place I want them to feel safe and loved. The place I want them to feel proud of. The place I want them to feel connected to me. These past three years, I've only acted like my home is where I put my clothes. Mav has been wanting a sense of home, and we are now building it together. But my kids haven't been invited into it. They don't know this home. They don't know Mav. They don't know me here. They don't know this version of me.

- They are my family, but this is my home.
- Jen is in my family. Mav is in my home.
- That is no longer my home. My family gets together at Jen's home.

What would it take for Mav to feel comfortable with my family?

---

Hey family,

Today, even though I'm not with you, I wanted you to know that I'm thinking of you. I miss catching up and going around the table and hearing what everyone is thankful for this year.

I'm thankful for family.

Over these past few years, I've bounced around a lot, trying to figure out who I am apart from being a husband and a home-maker. I've thought a lot about what HOME even means for me right now. I know I'm not alone in that! When we lose a home, it takes time to find a new one. You can feel alone, unsafe, unmoored. It takes it's toll on you in ways you took for granted when all the routines and conventions were in place.

I'm in the process of building a new home. I guess we're always building our homes. Right now, it's in [@Redmond](location:a2842c68-b71c-4940-932e-d6f79325990f), which I know is weird, maybe insane to you all, but it makes sense for me right now and I hope you all will eventually feel more comfortable visiting me.

But family is something else. Each of you is my family in my blood and bones. I'm sorry if that has become unclear during the reconfigurations of the past few years.

title: Testify in Max's trial
body:
Just testified in [@Max](person:059c7d9a-358e-483a-a9a3-4dce5820c47a)'s trial. I woke up this morning realizing that, if the pretrial motions went through that I may be the only one to say what escalated, what was said and realized I didn't have the "beats" down. I went through all my notes and tried to memorize things as quickly as possible. Then we went to the courthouse with [@Megs](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a).

Before I testified, the prosecutor gave me a piece of paper with what I couldn't say. It said I couldn't say any specific things I heard before the apartment. I asked the prosecutor what that meant... could I not say anything about X, Y, and Z? She said no, but she would clarify. So I shifted into trying to tell what I felt about everyone's "demeanor". 5 min before I testified she came back and said if I heard it I could say it, so I went back to cramming my beats.

I hit all the beats. I had to stop to collect myself twice. The jury seemed so sympathetic. 

In cross, Court [@Will](person:cd973382-4e3a-446d-bdb4-6f614b9a08fe), the DA asked very few questions. Did she text you saying she was worried about him committing suicide? I said "no" which was different than what I said in the pretrial interview. So he made a deal about that and I read off to the jury that I had said that but now didn't recall saying that. I think I recovered ok but I'm sure he's going to attempt to discount everything I said because of it.

Max was fat. Hidden behind the interviewers most the time. I hope he was rolling his eyes.

I went outside and smoked two cigarettes. Now sitting in [@Cherry Street coffee](location:0c742f82-d497-4b26-bfd9-6c4485865ed7). 

Shaky. Not sure how I feel about my participation in all of this. Will Max try to hunt me down later? Should I have given [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) more room when I came back from [@San Diego](location:5e412cfd-6b01-4367-85fd-9082dd93345b)? There are so many ways to tell a story truthfully. Did I choose the right one? The ethical one? With compassion for all involved?

He did everything I said. He took it to trial. I don't like the feeling of power he has over us, compelling us to go through this by his actions. I never wanted any of this.

This is what life is like. People do things that have consequences I can't control. Stoic would say control is an illusion anyway. Dao would say this kind of threat is natural. Don't fight it.

So what do I do? Grieve. Accept. Hold my head high. Pay attention to the next thing. Prepare for a future Max incident... but how?

title: Summary of 2025

Looking at your journal, 2025 was a year of profound personal transformation and difficult growth. Here are the major themes:

### Relationships & Family

**Divorce & Healing**: The year began with deep work on processing your divorce from [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c). By mid-year, you reached a place where you could acknowledge that neither of you were bad people—just incompatible.

**Co-parenting Journey**: The relationship with Jen went through intense cycles. March-April saw painful email exchanges, but by year's end (November-December), you achieved what seemed impossible at the start: establishing a functional co-parenting relationship and even planning to integrate [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) into family gatherings for Christmas.

    • Ports 80/443 on vm-resolve are almost certainly the amplifier-resolve web app serving legit public traffic — expected (though ideally behind Front Door/WAF; that's an architecture change, not a quick fix).

    Safe fix: restrict the  AllowSsh  rule source from  *  → [@Microsoft](organization:4ae25353-5ebb-4725-936a-84b5eb4684e4) CorpNet service tags ( CorpNetPublic  +  CorpNetSaw ). Since you connect via MSFT-AzVPN/corpnet, you keep SSH access, but the internet-at-large is locked out — the standard SFI-compliant remediation. (Alternatives: delete SSH entirely + use Bastion, or enable MDC just-in-time access.)
  - JIT for NonProd RBAC — 2-step PIM change touching your own  az-alt  Owner access + 2 colleagues; needs PIM admin

I want acceptance. I want well-wishing. I want my kids to feel that of their parents, to know we can resolve things, and that we've always got their backs, and I've been working towards that. body:
**Terms to keep in mind**

- mutual aid, voluntary association, civic projects
- build trust, mediate conflict, teach people how to work together; patience, compromise, shared responsibility, trust across differences
- things the government should fix vs. things the market should sell solutions to
- Trust is declining faster than participation, and participation is shifting toward affinity rather than locality

**Read / integrate — decentralized & alternative protocols**

IPFS, Hypercore (formerly DAT), Peerweb, Gopher, Gemini, Nightfall Express (nex), Spartan. These focus on decentralizing HTTP content (IPFS, Hypercore, Peerweb), reviving older protocols abandoned in the shift to HTTP (Gopher), or creating new protocols that are simple to set up and run (Gemini, nex, Spartan).

We must always think of bundles as within a directory/repo because they always might have self or other references using the `<bundle-name>:<something>` syntax. Therefore, our BUNDLES.txt file really must be pointing to a whole directory/repo and those directory/repos must be cached as a whole. In this case, it doesn't seem important to have a bundle be put in ~/.[@amplifierd](project:79287625-ebda-433d-af86-cab2dd5b8277)/share/bundles/ at all as all bundles are already references in the BUNDLES.txt (a type of registry) and can be used from the cache directory. I've gotten in the position so many times of asking amp to implement an early design, which it does quickly, and then finding certain things it got wrong and trying to correct them, only to end up days later not seeming to get anything to work... an anti-pattern I like to call "wondering into a dark alley". To attempt to avoid this this time, I have attempted to spend extra sessions on validating the initial design before implementation. I asked amp to verify it's design assumptions against actual code, write full implementation specs, verify those implementations against actual code, etc. For implementation, I spent extra time having it create a very structured implementation working directory, with prompts like "let's create a new working directory just for implementing this design, and, since, the design is big, I want you to talk to [@amplifier](project:d5f8fb75-ba6d-4a26-9795-0b42c1a139fb) expert about a strategy for ensuring it all gets implemented correctly", and then validated that with additional prompts and sessions. Since the design covers multiple components - core, foundation, cli, observers bundle, foundation bundle, I cloned all of those into the working dir and ensured they were all on a similarly named branch. amp set up the working dir with additional context about the implementation process, broke it into five phase-gates, created specific milestones for each including tests that needed to be written, and a validation recipe to be run to validate each phase is working.

Finally, I began the implementation session. It walked through the entire implementation across all four components (I'm not sure if I had updating the observers bundle in the plan), only prompting me at each phase whether I wanted to continue or not. I was able to do the entire implementation in one session.

At the end of the day, I was able to run a [@foreman](project:ea68d9fd-278f-4908-a2b3-81c97de756da) session with my smoke test "make me a calculator app in a new directory" and it worked first try, making issues, having workers pick up those issues and complete them, finishing the task.

title: Bedroom ambiance
body:
- 0.5

  - Clean, uncluttered, dark bedroom. Candle light. Lying in bed,
    covered. Stream of music on hi-def speakers to either side of
    me. Water. Ginger tea.

- 1.5-2.5

  - Affine transformations.... visual warps mingled with the music.
    Night vision increased. Depth perception in flux. I feel a warm
    weight on my stomach and genitals. My feet are cold. The air
    coming into my lungs feels cold and pure (the humidity may be
    too low at 40%, but climbing with the dehumidifier just turned
    on).

  - I'm anxious that the Youtube music radio algorithm may start
    playing something disruptive but then think about all the people
    who listened to all the things and how I'm trusting their
    choices in the data. I crack up at the idea that I don't have a
    guide/helper taking me through this experience, making sure I
    have the right environment and music and instead I have an
    algorithm. Trust in the algorithm!

  - Listening to Soteria by Mt Wolf: A bountiful love for [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c),
    wanting her to feel it and remember the wide-eyed affection of
    our youth. The feeling of being on an alcohol high, the "I love
    you!", but before any of us had used substances to get this
    high. Wanting to tap into that feeling of love, joy, pleasure,
    being young on the edge of exploration and a great journey
    ahead. Our love was forged there, and the story of our love is
    the resilience of that love through the challenges over the
    years. That's the desire, that we tap into that again...
    through more than wistfulness.

  - Whatever decisions we make in our relationship, I want them to
    be from the place of **absolute love** I feel for her.

  - The story I am in now is that I am trapped, that I can't get
    the love I want, that we've lost it or never had it. I now tap
    into that feeling that my love cannot be contained, that the
    power in **my love is my own** and nothing can stop me from
    giving it. I want to merge and **love from a place of power**.

  - Where our love went sideways was the **possessiveness** of
    marriage. That sense of ownership, of mandated loyalty from an
    external source. I never wanted the responsibility to enforce
    this ownership. I never wanted to own her. I have always wanted
    her to be free and to be able to keep loving her alongside her.
    I want her in my life, but I don't want to own her. The
    possessiveness, the external legal mandate, are the seeds of
    destruction of the love I want.

  - The compassion I feel for her is one element of the compassion I
    feel for everyone and everything. Compassion is one of a few
    fundamental drives of my life. Perhaps the most fundamental. I
    need to remember to keep living out of that and to extend it
    farther and more deeply. "**Endless expansive compassion**.
    That's the way." Compassion from a place of **reverence** (to
    the objects of my compassion).

  - Taking care of that love for [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c), keeping that place of safety
    and reverence gives my life meaning. It keeps all my efforts
    over the years from being an absurdity.

- 2.5 - 3.5

  - This feels exactly like the peak of drinking. I keep feeling the
    urge to have one more drink to keep the peak going and tell
    myself I shouldn't or I'll feel awful tomorrow, and then
    remember I'm not drinking.

  - I question If this reverent compassion state, this relational
    fixation is enough, or whether it is another form of chasing the
    high. Is becoming a guru, creating an ashram, surrounding
    ourselves with lovers a natural pursuit; or is it's
    unnaturalness betrayed by undeniable fact that one is
    defenseless while tripping, and the world will eat you up. Is
    this merely an altered state rather than a transcendent one? Are
    lovers just junkies? If this is the feeling of being high, what
    is it when you're not? Are compassion and devotion just
    longings to be high? If to be in relationship is to be human, is
    being human just chasing that relationship high?

  - Be the resonator, the damper, the one who absorbs and
    **regulates all things** [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c), [@Fiona](person:40f1bbfa-f375-4a65-84d9-1290fd02a3c7), [@Sinead](person:72a05873-c2c7-4de6-b5e2-ae6c2abcf2d3), work, pursuits...
    do this for the universe. Do this from an overarching sense of
    **gratitude** to my mother for bringing me into the world and to
    the universe for allowing me to be harmonic with it.

  - At this point, I just relax and observe my pose; lying in bed
    with one leg bent, foot on calf; one arm wrapped over my head
    with the other hand over my heart. I recognize this as the pose
    of my birth and feel the fear of this being my introduction into
    the world, surrounded by grasping doctors with an umbilical cord
    choking away my first breaths. I have a deep sense of compassion
    towards myself, towards **the fear** I faced, and also tap into
    a sense of **divinity**. I was a little buddha in my divine pose
    bringing benevolence and order into the world and I was received
    by strife. I feel what it must have felt to attempt to make
    sense of all of this from a prelingual, purely synaptic
    reaction. But this could not choke out my compassion, nor any
    other struggle since.

  - I recognize [@Fiona](person:40f1bbfa-f375-4a65-84d9-1290fd02a3c7)'s **timidness** and fear of not being capable
    as the same fear I had being born and I weep for her out of
    compassion. I resolve to hold her and comfort her.

  - I remember the feeling of being open and curious and sensorial
    **in my youth**, with fewer cares and more attachment to the
    ecosphere. I remember the joy and sense of feeling alive and
    have deep gratitude. I have a deep sense of sadness knowing
    [@Fiona](person:40f1bbfa-f375-4a65-84d9-1290fd02a3c7) and [@Sinead](person:72a05873-c2c7-4de6-b5e2-ae6c2abcf2d3)'s childhoods are nearly over and I haven't
    protected their connection here well enough; then I observe
    their evolution doesn't end when they leave our house; and that
    **we will always be family**.

  - I stop capturing thoughts, letting myself just be. Giving the
    rest of the experience as a gift to myself. Just breath, just
    feel, comfort, meditate.

- 4.5

  - I feel lonely and bored and hungry and done with lying in bed.
    With a feeling of caretaking of myself, I get up, eat, watch tv,
    take a bath.

- Next day

  - The overall experience I am working to incorporate is that of
    purpose of regulating the frequencies of the world around me. I
    want to live in a state of flow and invite others to join with
    me. Also, a deeper respect for [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) and others who live more
    continuously from this place of wonder and receptivity rather
    than where I usually am, cognitive, assertive, reactive, and
    generally unaware of the flow.

title: No cycles in life
body:
- Apr 8, 2021

  - There are no cycles in life. There are sometimes the opportunity
    to interact with familiar dynamics, but no one steps in the same
    river twice. Apply your learnings but be present and choose.

  - I am a passenger in life. And yet. I have agency. What do I do
    with this sacred, yet insignificant power?

  - All I want to do is connect with someone. Do you feel what I do
    when you see the rocks and water, the sunlight, the beauty (this
    is shit... but it's the point)? If I could just get you to feel
    what I feel, I wouldn't feel alone. What more can one ask?

  - What does it mean to be alone in a world of beauty?

  - Why do I want to own a forest? Why is just taking care of it for
    someone else so unsatisfying? It's because the only way to
    guarantee longevity is to own it. But what if I could just be a
    life-long ranger? Then [@Trump](person:519c0ad2-5afa-46bb-b619-239e77bfb342) could drill that shit. Fuck him.
    Fuck all yall.

  - For my part:

    - I should not have asked her to marry me after 6 weeks of
      commitment. Even these six weeks were a struggle. In the
      ensuing weeks, I already knew it was a mistake. I went
      through with it out of guilt, not wanting to hurt her. I
      knew she wasn't that into me. I wanted to lock her in while
      she was in a liking mood. I hoped it would last, but I knew
      it wouldn't.

    - I knew this when I went to our premarital "counselor" and
      I let him bully me into it.

    - I failed to stand up for myself. I relegated myself. I
      didn't demand the love I deserved. I settled. I gave up my
      own pursuits and my own relationships. I turned my back on
      the world. I shut myself down. I became a household monk. I
      gave up the joy in my life. I gave the parts of me that
      should not have been given. I didn't respect myself, esteem
      myself, love myself enough. I "chronically self-abandoned
      and disappeared myself to try to win her favor". I was "an
      insecure man desperately giving myself away to try to gain
      her approval". I thought this was love. I thought this
      would make her love me.

    - I was so immature. Never having had a relationship. I
      blundered into 23 years because I was too scared to date
      anyone before [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c). I had no idea how to love a woman, so it
      was hard to trust me. Our relationship was shaky from the
      start.

    - I failed to negotiate directly and forthrightly. I was
      afraid to hear the truth so I did whatever I could to avoid
      it while occupying us with the safer edges. I allowed us to
      be in a non-speaking, clouded communication relationship
      where neither of us really said what was most true.

    - I chose someone clearly unavailable. I repeated the story of
      unlovability from my past.

  - Jen attacks people. She is mean spirited and selfish. She is
    afraid of the world and needs to have control over all of her
    small relationships. She is afraid of intimacy. She needs to
    keep me small by tearing me down and occupying me with her
    anxieties.

  - How do I wish I had been loved? What commitments do I wish my
    partner had made to me (that I can now make to myself?)

    - Our love facing inward

      - Seeing who I am and adoring me for it.

      - Unflinchingly. Decisively. With abandon.

      - Without shame. Naked and joyful.

      - With creativity and beauty.

      - Given comfort when weary and support when afraid.

      - With expansiveness and a sense of adventure.

    - Our love facing outward

      - Being my biggest fan.

      - Operating as a team. Us vs. the world.

      - Engaging with society. Not angry and separate from the
        world.

      - Not needing to keep me small.

title: Dream about driving accidents
body:
Dreams in three parts.

First, [@Shaughn](person:32f526b6-b1f3-4cf7-bbb1-8428b223c505) driving almost kills us... spin-slide on a bridge to a
house over a ravine that ends up being his parents. We join them for a
family holiday feast. I express my anger and confusion at Shaughn's
driving and they respond with deep offense; tell me I need to be more
flexible. I am ashamed and try to repair with them. We sit at the table
to start eating and I realize I am dressed sloppily and am worried about
being an additional offense, so I leave to change, but trying to find my
good clothes in the guest room is difficult---my things aren't where I
left them. Eventually some dinner party members appear in the guest room
and inform me I missed dinner entirely, and I have offended even more
deeply by not receiving in their generosity. I return upstairs to repair
with the mother who has prepared my a plate. I apologize profusely.

Second (or was it first?), [@Casey](person:f57f348a-25f8-4be2-b1e2-711d1199839e) driving my CR-V. Stupidly. Barrelling
down the road. Tries to pass a car in the oncoming lane, but it is a
construction zone and the oncoming lane is incomplete. He starts to
merge back into his lane, but there is a barrier. I grab the wheel to
prevent him from ruining the wheels. A policeman is directing traffic at
the end of the lineup and looks at us quizically. I am embarassed and
think Casey will slow down for me to deal with the situation. Instead he
accelerates and spins off to the left into a yard and we run into a
house. The policeman pursues. The rest of the dream is spent attempting
to create rapport with the officer, make excuses for my brother, explain
how I was dumb for letting him drive, hoping to get off the ticket.
Rapport is created and we exit the house to return to the
intersection... not yet knowing what the penalty will be.

Third. In a conference or something in a foreign city, like [@Calcutta](location:0aa98437-739f-4345-ad0d-511ff6ab9412)...
ancient with masses of people. Packing to return home. Similar/same room
as first part. Ryan, maybe Jason waiting to get to the airport. Same
fiasco trying to find my things. Other people keep moving them, new
people moving in. I am continually presented with new problems. Finally
I grab enough of them and I _must_ leave so I rush out the door with my
rolling bag and a few other things. Following a group of people through
winding streets to a conference center. Inside the doors I enter a
restroom. As one pees in a machine, the weight of the urine releases
cookies and candy in a chute to fill a cup held beneath. I return to
the center, my mates have moved on into a presentation or something that
I know I am meant to join, I look for somewhere to stash my bag; try a
shop just inside the doors. As I'm negotiating with the keepers to hold
onto it, and pulling a few things out of the bags to take with me, we
all catch a glimpse of the massive amount of cash inside one of the
compartments. I realize this is not a safe place to keep my bag. I
return outside and wonder the streets a bit; realize I will be late for
my flight and mates are waiting for me; on my way back to the center I
see a section of homeless people on mats selling (?) nice bank-branded
fabric cash bags. I think they could use some money and the bags are
nice and approach to purchase. There is a slight commotion as they jump
into action and make room for me and almost immediately as I kneel down
I realize what is happening; I look back and realize I had let go of my
bag and it is now gone. It was just a moment ago, so I look frantically
searching for who is surely rushing away with it. All I see is one of
the homeless with a slightly smaller, pink, rolling bag rushing away.
Seeing no one else to pursue, I pursue after him through the heavy
pilgrimage crowds. I see he has a carpet knife on his hip so I approach
him slowly trying to decide---confront---follow? A police man bustles up
to me---followed (unknowingly?) by four or five women. I don't know if
he is after me, or the thief, if he is aware of the women behind him. He
seems like he is expressing he is there to help me, and is aware of what
is going on, so I grow concerned the thief will kill him. I try to
explain to the police the thief has a knife but he isn't listening to
me; so while he is talking, I grab ahold of the thief's wrists to
prevent him from using his knife. The thieve's eyes acknowledge a bit of
respect in my wisdom and success at preventing him.

I wake in a fit of anxiety and disorientation and ponder:

- Clearly I am afraid of losing my things and offending people. Of not
  being in control; not equipped; not on time; not understanding where
  I am supposed to be, what or how. I feel everything is crowded;
  everything moving fast; I labor to pacify authority figures.

- Effects are useless (towing a bag of unknown possessions). Instead of
  trying so hard to manage them (control); it's better to live without
  (give up control---trust).

- Why did I care so much about offending? Speak the truth. Shaughn
  almost killed us.

This is all why the legend of Lau Tzu as the dragon is such a siren song
to me.

body:

So, I'll need to think more about your perspective of their situatedness, because I (and Mav) just haven't personally experienced it.

JEN:

I think some of that is based on the impression that you don't want or need her to be important to us which, no offense to Mav, is where we're looking for cues. You're out guy, you started dating someone and don't seem to care much if we know her. I hear you on the experiences you've had, they sound like little litmus tests, and I can understand those being discouraging. But we're looking to you for leadership and in this family where yes I'm the queen bee, no I'm not a gatekeeper, yes everyone probably still has feelings about you dumping me, no people aren't being vengeful or spiteful about it, yes people are open to you and love you and want you to be part of us and are sad you've removed yourself as far away as you have.... I think we all feel pretty rejected and confused about how much we matter to you. Of course there are nuances in there with our kids, bigger nuances with me naturally... But as a group we don't know what you want or how important we are to you.

Let's please retire allllllll presence of a request I made for a little pacing at the very very beginning of you starting to dat Mav, someone who you had only had drama rama with up to that point. :)

In case it's not obvious from what I'm saying, I still do not give a FUCK about divorce rules, breakup rules, and no one else really does either. They do feel protective of me and look to me for cues, and I keep torying to roll out some version of the red carpet.

I think I tried too hard with that and crowded you at points earlier on but whatever, I'd rather err on the side of advocating for friendship and family.

I empathize with Mav coming into a family space with such big presences as [@Miss](person:e49a542a-d5c6-4ea0-ac32-fdc625cf6f79) and me :) :O but like, jesus christ, we're warm hospitable and loyal women and Mav will only benefit from having us in her corner. I will pour it on with her, as I do, I served you two bitches coffee at a moment's notice looking like shit and I was so fucking nice. :)

I'm sure you're picking up on something of Miss' loyalty to me, ashe's my bitch and I'm hers and I was so so devastated last year getting kicked out of your life, I get that you and I have our versions of why that happened, but she's probably not signed onto Mav all the way until it's clear I'm ok, hurtful things aren't happening to me, etc. She's also wildly stressed and busy and has never give two shits about my dating life, I think out of preservation of energy and investment. Wanting to know it's worth precious resources to invest in a new person.

ME: It's really good to hear your perspective on things. I think calling the litmus tests is a bit dismissive, but I really feel the leadership charge. People shouldn't be confused about how much they mean to me, and with our kids, especially, they need to know clearly what my expectations are of what being my kid means. I've given them a pass for a long time, been way too hands off, waiting for them to reciprocate affection, and it's not a place I want to be. 

Yes, you and Miss (and F and [@S](person:72a05873-c2c7-4de6-b5e2-ae6c2abcf2d3)) are strong women, and so very intense, I love that about you. Mav is also strong and intense, but also like, like everyone, tender. And I am protective. She would clearly be the outsider in a tight knit culture almost impossible to navigate safely, and I don't want to ask her to be in that place unless I am more secure in MY place. So, I am intent on that right now. The first step for me is building more trust with you, which I think starts with focusing on that ease and support.

JEN: I disagree about safety inside this family culture but that's ok.

Sure I still don't really know how that trust is being built but I'll stay open to how you want to move with this.

With our kids :) I'll just say that desire and collaboration work better than "expectations" but again, I respect your autonomy there.

title: Financial expectations discussed
body:
You asked to reevaluate our relationship with expectations that the
areas we weren't fulfilled in weren't going to be met by the other and
with a willingness to be better friends and be willing to allow us to
have those needs met outside one another. You had been reading about
Relational Anarchy and had read PolySecure. You were tired of my
expectations of sex and intimacy and your unmet expectations of kindness
and liking.

I read PolySecure and studied RA and agreed. We should take a break from
expectations and really ask ourselves what a new contract could look
like. I suggested we use RA categories and start with the things we know
we wanted from each other and negotiate back in what felt good for us. I
suggested I wanted to separate finances, we should keep being parents
and nesting partners, and question our emotional intimacy, sex, physical
intimacy, and emotional support over the upcoming weeks. You agreed and
suggested a series of times to keep dating and discussing. We settled
into this rhythm for a couple weeks.

You were ok with the idea of splitting finances until I presented an
actual plan to separate out non-household expenses and suggested you
should pay for half of household expenses even though your new practice
isn't fully going yet. My reasoning: 1) you said you were going to
increase your income quickly, 2) I gave you _all_ the free cash and all
the next year's vesting [@MSFT](organization:4ae25353-5ebb-4725-936a-84b5eb4684e4) stock, and 3) I am paying for both kid's
entire college (\> \$200k). This made you mad.

You said I didn't consider you enough, that I knew you needed more
interim support and that I humiliated you by making you ask for it. Then
you said I betrayed you. You said I was doing the typical patriarchy
thing. Then you said I was no longer the stable, grounded support, that
I was dropping my half of our relationship. Then you asked what else I
was going to bring to our relationship if not that. Then you said you
weren't going to keep bringing your relationality and skills if I wasn't
going to be doing my part. Then you said I killed our life partnership.

The reality is that I _did_ consider you\--my proposal left you with not
needing to work or contribute _at all_ for 14 months (or at half
capacity, like you are now, for nearly _two years_) before we would
reach an even split.

So, if by asking to split our finances I "killed our life partnership",

| | |
| Money | Relationality |

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+

For life.

If this is how you've viewed our partnership, then it explains much
about why I've been dissatisfied for so long. I've never been happy
being the only one who is concerned about money, making it, investing
it, planning for kids' college and retirement. I have never been happy
with how freely you spend it while I'm trying to do this. I resent being
told I am too concerned about money while I'm holding all this. At the
same time, I've never been happy with the relationality of our
partnership. Neither of us has really gotten what we want. I don't feel

| | |

For life.

title: Simulation anxiety
body:
- I was not prepared for this experience. I needed someone with me as
  backup, I needed privacy, more time, and S to be taken care of.

- I am terrified of losing my ego. I so wanted a connection, a soul,
  J, E, someone to keep me grounded. As soon as it started happening I
  didn't want to be there. I wanted it to be over the entire time.
  Whenever I wasn't in a trance, I would want to know what time it
  was. I needed to get back into the SW.

- Anxiety

  - Super worried about [@Sinead](person:72a05873-c2c7-4de6-b5e2-ae6c2abcf2d3) (my responsibilities) in the SW.
    Super concerned that if I lost my mind, I would be dropping S.
    Really worried about her judgement of me.

  - Really concerned that I imposed on him and her.

  - Knew this guilt and shame is part of the ego, but I needed to
    hold onto it to not mess up this simulation run. I was trying to
    maintain a connection to the SW while examining the construct.

- It's all a simulation. What we experience daily is a simulated world
  (SW).

- Was she clearing my energy? I could feel her presence beyond her
  body... like a thread/tether that passed through the recurrences.

- Reverence, respect, honoring. I have not done this enough of others,
  or the world. My big ego has kept me dumb (not seeing, treating
  others and myself with cruelty). I thought I knew what people were
  talking about re: psychedelics, ego, self, etc. But I really didn't.
  There are other ways of experiencing the world entirely dependent on
  one's mind / aka bootloader.

  - I was compelled to throw away all my buddhist shit trappings...
    bowls, saffron shirt, beaded bracelet. Using them felt like I
    am being offensive.

  - I was also mad at buddhism... like they are layering doctrine on
    top of the simulation and don't really know they are trapped.

  - But then, suffering was the best word for trying to escape the
    recurrence. But then the response to exit the recurrence through
    heart feels like an escape.

  - Either we chose to be in the simulation or we are imprisoned
    here. Neither option feels like a recipe for blissing out.

- Thirsty.

- There were no lights / colors /etc. I was in a absolutely real
  alternate dimension... like a mirror dimension. Perception was at
  the edges. I could zone out or perceive.

- Souls. We're in the simulation together, each playing our part. The
  bodies we perceive are avatars.

- Realized my own body, my own avatar, needs some help... tight hips,
  tight back, teeth hurt, cigarettes, liquor... compulsion to eat
  clean food.

- How petty my judgments matter. Judgments about him.

- I wanted cleanliness and order.

Things I experienced re: the simulation:

- Its based on recursion.

- Time is inside the simulation, and is one type of sequential flow
  that happens only when in full surrender to the simulation, but the
  stack could be popped, the record could skip, and moments can be
  reconstructed. and is different, or non-existent outside.

- Things looped.

- What is the "I" that is in the simulation?

- I was stuck/imprisoned by the mechanics of it.

  - The only way to not experience suffering was to bliss out.

  - But blissing out means surrendering to the simulation, which is
    just another form of giving up.

  - All souls are these things, like "me" put into the simulation.

  - But trying to meet the "me" was structurally impossible, as it
    seemed to take my mind, which was not available. The only route
    was through heart/compassion, but that felt like I would need to
    die, or give up and dissolve my ego... then what would be left
    of "me".

- I could kind of project out of the recursion to the simulated world
  (sw) if I needed to connect with him or her. If they asked me a
  question, I would be pulled outward, and would need to reconnect
  with my body and speech.

- Intention seemed non-mind. It seemed part of the soul.

- All of the thinking parts seem less important, all the doing things
  parts seem less important. Like they are less important because
  they're not real.

What then is the importance of living. Why have we been jacked in?

title: Feelings matter
body:
Therapy w/ [@Konstantin](person:be69bae2-96ff-4595-92a6-a831c8bec010):

- Girls: I want you to know that I did not divorce you, too. I want to know you're ok.
- My deep disires: 1) Belonging to a community I respect. 2. Having a stable place that's my own.
- I seem to find it nearly impossible to advocate for myself.
  - I need to make sure everyone else is ok before I'm ok. And when they are, then I can fade away and focus on me. What an awful place to live from. I have seldom experienced people who took responsibility for being ok for themselves, and especially have seldom experienced people who stopped me when they found me functioning for them. Instead, they have made me responsible for them. I feel like I'm responsible for the whole world. I need to stop.

From Jung:

🪷 To your inner child, I would say:

Hello there, young Paul. I want you to know that your feelings are important, and it's okay for you to express them. You don't have to take on the weight of the world or feel responsible for everyone else being okay. Your feelings and needs matter, just as much as everyone else's. You deserve to feel safe, loved, and secure, knowing that you are enough just as you are.

You are cherished for who you are, not for what you do for others. It's alright to take care of yourself and find joy in your own interests and dreams. I'm here to support you, so you don’t have to navigate everything alone. You're allowed to have days where you simply focus on being and feeling "ok" within yourself. Your peace is important, and it's safe to seek it.

Feel free to play, explore, and be compassionate to yourself. You’re not alone, and you are truly and deeply loved.

I understand it's hard to trust that you're truly enough and that it's okay to shift focus to yourself. It's completely natural to have doubts, especially after
carrying these responsibilities for so long.

It's okay to feel uncertain. Over time, and with small steps, we can slowly build this trust together. You have so much strength within you to take this one step at a time. You're not expected to change overnight. Know that it's not about suddenly changing everything or being indifferent to others; it's okay to still care, but we're learning to hold that care alongside caring for yourself too. It's about balancing your compassion for others with compassion for yourself, and that takes time and practice. You’re learning to nurture both.

How does this feel to you? It’s important that you hear what resonates most naturally with the needs of your inner child.

We can keep practicing, and it's perfectly okay if it takes time; you're learning a new way of being. You're doing your best, and that is more than enough. Remember, you're not alone in this—it’s okay to seek the support you need along the way.

It's important to honor these feelings and let your inner child know that doubts are part of the process, and they're allowed to take the time they need to adjust.

Mantras:

1. "I am worthy of care and love, just as I am."
2. "My needs are important and deserve attention."
3. "I can hold space for myself and others with balance."
4. "Every step forward is a victory, no matter how small."
5. "It’s safe to honor my feelings and experiences."
6. "I am enough, and my peace is valuable."
7. "I nurture myself with kindness and patience."
8. "Caring for myself is part of caring for others."
9. "I am free to explore what brings me joy and peace."
10. "My well-being is a priority, not an afterthought."

It’s wild to me you’re “surprised” I don’t (keep on) acknowledging my part in things as if I didn’t spend hours and hours and hours listening to you and acknowledging and recognizing your experience about all of it. I initiated I think four? many-hours-long conversations April 2023, going over with a fine-toothed comb your pain and your experience, including how the breakup went down, and I didn’t ask for the same in return about mine with you. I made it about you. And there were many other hours besides that. The amount of recognition you want about your pain seems endless Paul. I’m so deeply relieved to not have to engage you any longer about any of it. It has been the most draining thing I’ve ever done relationally, not because I didn’t want to do it, but because - this is the thing you’re not acknowledging - once you had a girlfriend, it was like none of that repair had even happened. We were in bed fucking Christmas morning 2023 because we’d made a ton of peace with each other about our history, which I devoted myself all the way to, and by March of 2024, I was being ghosted by you. I understand rage comes on the scene when it does and it doesn’t always make sense, but it’s like you have amnesia about alllllll I poured into recognition of your pain. Again, without asking for the same in return. Nothing I do is effective with you and I’m beyond glad to be done trying. This absence of you... caring? remembering? how much I poured into you, into repair with you, into trying to foster a different relationship AFTER you broke up with me is so hurtful and soooo maddening that I’m having a pretty hard time hanging onto any desire to collaborate with you about anything. Our kids will be better for it and that’s important to me but the amount I want to be done with you is huge. Your version of La Copa is that I erred on the side of too friendly?? Fuckkkkkk.

I need you to understand the reality here which is that the amount I don’t fuck with you is almost all the way and you continuing to think you get to say whatever you want to say about what you think you’re owed and what is your due from me is enormously destructive to any desire I have to try to create something amenable with you on behalf of our kids.

J
```

Then me:

```
You're right, I don't remember what we talked about in April 2023. I looked back on my journal and apparently you were offering for us to have a remote partner arrangement. I don't recall the 4+ hours of talking about my anger. I'm sure we did.

As I told you at the coffee house, I wasn't ghosting you, I was distracted. I do want to give you an explanation. I can't share details, but I will say that my girlfriend almost died, traumatically, in February last year. It was horrible. Before this, you had made it very clear you didn't want her around and didn't want to hear anything about our relationship. I chose to focus on her recovery. I thought we were generally ok at the time and didn't expect your emails in the summer. I should have stayed more in touch with you during those months. I'm sorry I didn't.

You're right, last August, I did say I wasn't sure I wanted to have a personal relationship beyond co-parenting if you dismiss my experience. You said you also felt the same towards me. And when we had coffee, you said you wanted more connection and were worred about the kids and I said I might be able to if I can process my anger. When you wrote that I burned everything to the ground and you poured it all out, I didn't recognize you were talking about those moments. I was actually processing my anger to get to a place where we could have more connection, and I thought you knew that, so the perspective you shared in your email last week was confusing to me.

I hear you loud and clear that you don't want to open any of this up again and that talking about it isn't helpful. Ok. I'm done. If I'm jeopardizing collaborating over our kids, like you say, then I'm done.

Needing to create my own traditions with the girls became a necessity as soon as you disinvited me to [@Fiona](person:40f1bbfa-f375-4a65-84d9-1290fd02a3c7)'s 21st and continued in that vein. I should have focused on that sooner. You've been entirely in control of whether or not I am allowed to be in "the family". How am I supposed to build with my daughters with you being the gatekeeper??

Whatever... you are very clear in saying you are done with me. I can't tell what you actually want regarding creating something better for our kids.

P.
```

Then her on the 5th:

```
Paul,

[@Jen Lemen](person:c5978e91-5df2-4130-93a7-f957515cec83) has talked me down off the ledge twice this week of really pulling the plug with you. I’ve been kind of undone with how much fury and hurt I feel re: you.

(She doesn’t take sides and is absolutely genius at systems so you should keep her in mind if you ever want coaching on that front, western psychology therapists are fuckin’ abysmal about communal ways of being.)

I’m truly so bewildered and sad that you don’t even remember all those repair conversations. There were multiple, multiple. On one hand, it’s possible not remembering is because repair was effective. On another hand, it can feel like I wasted so so much of my goddam time.

From the very beginning of knowing you there’s always been so much profound frustration trying to relate to you, be understood by you, understand you. It’s why going back into a personal relationship with you isn’t something I want to touch with a thousand foot pole.

Like, jesus christ man, if your girlfriend is almost dying, let me support you!! My intention was, don’t ask me to be involved in this relationship until I know it’s gonna maybe stick, given the volatility and drama from before. Not total mum’s the word about anything, particularly when you’re having a horrible time.

Blarghghgh.

I’m still open to the question/project of sharing family space together. We’ll both be at Fiona’s show. I’ll be polite and zero drama. Thankfully there’s no urgency to figure anything else out right this minute. That’s all I got right now.

[@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c)

Yeah, I know you've been often profoundly  frustrated with relating with me.

P.

Today I sent her back a picture ouf our kids when they were very young.

I have no idea what I'm doing.

title: Secure attachment ideas
body:
I read Polysecure. It introduces some nice ideas I guess. Namely that we
need to find security in ourselves. Attacks the couple bubble.

I don't like her focus on attachment commitment I think I've been
contemplating SP or RA their line I do like the recommendation to
disentangle the structure of a relationship from the attachment in a
relationship.

"secure attachment is an embodied expression built upon how we
consistently respond in attuned to each other not something that gets
created through structure and hierarchy"

Secure bases. Something to venture forth from.

Safe havens. Somewhere to find respite nearby and accessible available
responsive and attuned.

Questions for myself:

- can I love freely with no expectation of solo?
- Can others love me with no expectation of solo?
- _Why do I want so much to be seen and loved unconditionally?_
- Why don't I like the authors focus on attachment?
- Do I want to be [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c)'s secure base or is this what I'm trying to
  escape?
- I have the notion that I would be committed to SP until the first
  beautiful woman shows interest in me.
- Jen is not my secure base. She is at most my safe haven.

Questions for Jen:

- how will a new arrangement help you get what you want? Relationally?
  Do you see yourself wanting secure attachments with others?
- Why does Jen want to stay in relationship with me if I do not
  provide her with a attunedness?

General questions:

- What do we do with the fear of abandonment?

title: Fears and choices
body:
[@Phil](person:520138a2-a693-433f-ab2d-0fbe191ece6a) and [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) just text all the time now. I'm breaking up with him this

I have fears.

- That I will be trapped in a commitment.
- That I won't seen or loved.
- That I'll need to care for an invalid... not getting my own needs
  met.
- That their insecurities and brokenness will take me down with them.
- That I won't have time to be truly great.
- That I'll be isolated from other meaningful relationships.

This is all manageable with Mav. I can leave at any point, now or 7
years from now if she is unwilling to meet my needs. I can show empathy
for what she deals with without feeling responsible to give up my
pursuits to shoulder it. I can maintain my own grounding: choose my

What about my desire for RA... solo poly... many different independent,

that I am my own partner. Maybe this is actually the way. Then. Find the

trying to be a good friend with everyone. Serve my own aims, find the

title: How to love openly
body:
[@M](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a)'s bday party yesterday. [@E](person:fdea51c7-a6b8-47db-b18f-1a5e375a96d3) booked a limo. Bookstore in [@Tacoma](location:30217b13-f8b3-436a-8859-0e92577afb10).
Idiocracy.

Haunted by negative thoughts... what have I destroyed, what have I given
up, is there a way to get it back---solo poly, or settle back into what
was before. I am feeling like the perspective I've been finding may make
me a better lover with [@J](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c), so it could happen. I could gi back to a f rel
with M.

But all this seems off balance. I want to pursue positive thoughts.

- How to be more alive?
- How to pursue dreams of discovery and capability?
- How to deepen into soul?
- How to assemble capable friends?
- How to find all the resources I need.

I need to entrepreneur. Write. Lead. Refuse to settle.

So, how does this person love? He loves others who are alive and learns
from their interactions. He develops deep friendships. He does not shy
away from their shadows. He encourages life. He does not control. He is
not controlled.

I would need, then, to firmly believe that not restricting my love to
one person is truly the best life for them. Perhaps my ultimate
commitment is to life itself and creating exclusivity anywhere else
would be abandoning my true love.

...

Desire and sex are natural expressions of living. What if we all
accepted them in our interactions with one another?

What then of someone who wants interaction from you ([@Shannon](person:6d6288dc-8001-418b-bc76-6e6af4247b1b)) that feels
cheap? We are not bound to reciprocate. Life asks us to not join them in
their self-harm.

What then of [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c)? Can I explore life affirmation with her while not
nullifying my own?

Can I have life-affirming relationships with everyone? No grasping? No
pushing away?

no "to a room full of people". She has dates without telling me
initially... keeping secrets... had a good date with "[@Tyler](person:fde588b5-df10-4009-996f-4214043e5db1)". She wants
me but wants me to say we are "dating" and wants to be exclusive. She
casts it as "What is wrong with me? Why don't you want me enough?". She
was mean about it, ridiculing my age and how she was more wise than me,
making fun of me. That type of violence makes me resolve to putting on
the brakes. Lean into compassion and away from desire.

Meet [@J](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) this morning. Her heart is still broken. She doesn't want the
relationship offered right now as it is too painful for her. She
believes everything I want is offered to me and can't understand what
it is I need.

I want to be seen. I want to be cherished. I want to be respected. I
want to be desired. I want to not be taken for granted. I don't want to
give up my life to be a footnote in someone else's.

These women want me to confirm to their model: validate their
desirability by giving them all. It's a model drilled into their brains
by a lifetime of storytelling about the prince who saves her because he
is smitten.

I am not that prince. I don't want to love just one person. I want all
people to have love, to experience being desired and accepted, to be
seen. But having this experience makes them want to lick it on, to own
it. Being unable to makes them despair.

I can understand why monks avoid passion. Perhaps there is no way to be
addicted.

At the very least, I can accept that M and J want me locked and be
compassionate in my engagement with them.

title: Progress on healing
body:
I've made progress this week on healing my heart and starting to live
more fully.

Set up my calendar and really started using it. Started using Instagram.
Created a Telegram group for friend meetups... not getting a lot of
traction, yet, but it's a new concept for people and I don't have enough
women and others participating. However, I have been out almost every
night the past two weeks with someone. [@Gabriel](person:17c8a97e-679f-4949-9edc-beaf655b97e8) was a god-send on Friday
night. [@Ernie](person:fdea51c7-a6b8-47db-b18f-1a5e375a96d3), David and [@Jalika](person:65566697-66d3-42ae-b7a3-7a34cf6d452a) and [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) at Folk Festival Sun afternoon.
[@Sinead](person:72a05873-c2c7-4de6-b5e2-ae6c2abcf2d3) at [@Flint Creek](location:ccd8567f-5b40-4d6a-a1fc-49cd234fe6b1) on Wed. [@Ace](person:e9ffae01-6432-407a-ac95-fa4973c01fc8), [@Alex G.](person:5c7c3729-e519-4592-a638-309773000821), and [@Paul](person:60728a93-af99-4c80-994a-a6e8c1bba47f) last Monday. Trying
to get some dates going... Friday ping-pong ghosted me. Going to walk [@MS](organization:4ae25353-5ebb-4725-936a-84b5eb4684e4)
campus for a bit on Tue.

Ordered a couch. Bought some new clothes. Started jogging and lifting.
Stopped smoking... kinda.

Still haven't been eating much. I'm dedicated to getting the fat off my
ass.

Just sent a msg to the [@AI Society](organization:bde5c7c9-c742-4b3b-bbfd-fbe84fcfb414) saying we need to fight the male
mono-culture. I'm so booooorrrrreeed with groups of men.

All of this has served to start opening my heart up more. The cuff key
around my neck has really shifted in symbolism from refusing to be
locked into a relationship, to refusing for my heart to be locked away
by the neglect of my parents and Jen; refusing to not allow other
people's love to come in anymore.

I want to receive so much love.

I've also had moments of feeling like, YES this! About the next few
years, maybe even about legacy. I lose them so easily, though... I think
they're things like:

- Building out a simple product like sms-inspiration that just adds
  happiness to people.

- Volunteering to build systems for eco-villages and visiting them.

- Getting rid of more cruft... more possessions, many books yesterday.

- Leaning into my taste on all things... becoming a true individual.

- Pressing my voice on instagram... a voice of aware optimism. Maybe
  making that my voice in general.

Instagram post this morning from someone said something like "We need to
stop trying to be the best, and work towards being the only". This makes
so much sense for me. _Just become me and put it out there_.

title: Heartbreak and therapy
body:
Slept two hours last night. Lined up an online therapy apt. Hung with
[@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) last night and. It was ok, but boring. Soothing. I shared my
heartbreak about [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) a little and she was actually helpful in her
immediate recognition why it would work (I'm aware of the bias).

Couldn't sleep all night again. This is miserable. Kept feeling her
touch, remembering how her body felt on mine. Maybe there is something
to keeping bodies until commitment, but how'd that work out with Jen?

5am, I wanted to see what was going on around the time of Mav sending a
ticket to [@Phil](person:520138a2-a693-433f-ab2d-0fbe191ece6a) for hairfest, Apr 24^th^. It was me asking for what I
need. I almost sent this to her but decided to put it here instead:

This is an excerpt from my journal:

_Things took a turn for my heart for a few reasons. Last Wed night
\[April 12\], I think, I shared my anxiety with Mav about some of her
statements: "I feel like you think I'm broken and want to me to get
therapy", "I don't think anyone should ask anyone else to change...
either they fit or they don't", "I want to find someone whose brokenness
fits my brokenness", "I like being with Phil, he's not intense like you
and just makes me happy", "This isn't how relationships are usually",
"I'm not used to this level of transparency", "This is what dating is,
btw, it's two people figuring out if they fit or not"... I was really
surprised by that last one... it felt like my commitment to us was
different than hers._

It's ironic in the end that it wasn't my lack of commitment to a life
with you, it was your unwillingness to confront your issues for us.
Instead, you ran to Phil.

The clear picture is as soon as I brought needs to her, wanting to
change something about our relationship, she quit. We went to [@Sultan](location:84de30d0-ae79-4e79-bd91-580a67a56ce9) and
didn't fuck. When we got back she started massive PMDD with suicidal
thoughts. During this time she asked Phil to hairfest and spent a day
with him in her house. When she started her period and started feeling
better, we met at [@Cairde](location:3cea7b98-c0bd-48ff-a58d-aa393ae08fdc) pub after she didn't text me all day and she
was pissy. And asked me about travel. Did Phil put her up to that? She
was so nervous, I thought because she was worried about me still liking
her, but it was probably a test I failed. Two days later, I tried again
to express my needs and she ran to Phil and broke up with me.

So, these are truths to remember:

- As much as she wanted you, she didn't want to change herself for
  you. She can't face her fears and won't get help.

- She was keeping Phil around since March and working to be with him
  for a month, at least. She liked him more.

- This means she just wanted me as a narcotic and a way out of [@Mike](person:daa03237-51b1-4c72-8461-9ec5385b6636). I
  was used.

- Happy as Fuck.

title: Autonomy rules considered
body:
Made up with [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) yesterday. She proposed coming up with autonomy rules.
She reasserted she might be ok with an open relationship. I want her so
badly. I want my autonomy more.

Spent time considering the relational ladder... have like 20 steps on
it.

- Loyal to myself above all.

  - Don't lock into a relationship that no longer works out of a
    misguided sense of loyalty. This means, no promises.

- Pursue life experiences. Life is short.

  - Fuck many women. Love all the kinds... Mav, hippies, tantric
    yogas, artists, divas.

  - Pursue opportunities to make an impact.

- Be compassionate to others.

  - Clear communication.

  - Kindness.

  - Allowing to change.

I guess this all means do anything on the smorgasbord below commitment
level. Can this be good enough for anyone? To be loved as an individual
with no fear of abandonment (because why would I?) and allowed to move,
flex, change as you see fit.

I believe it can be good for those who are independent, too. Those who
have a solid core in and of themselves, who accept love and joy and
pleasure without a need to control it or own it, recognizing that people
and situations always change. Who are willing to let go when the time is
good or hold on when the times get tough and it still makes sense. A
career woman who wants simple joys, a hippie who wants to experience
free love, a couple who wants adventure, anyone who just wants the
momentary rush of someone new.

This goes against coupling impulse, the biological urge to procreate and
rear offspring. That urge convinces us in our bones that one person
needs to be allied with, exclusive. This goes against the dream that
someone else will save us, complete us. Our true love.

But the cost of a true love is demand; resentment; equivocation;
compromise; stagnancy... a nullification of self-knowledge, autonomy.
One must hold "they ARE my true love! They WILL be with me forever! They
WILL save me!" which of course, can never be true, which requires more
and more self-delusion as awareness increases. This delusion comes in
the firm of blaming oneself, sacrificing one's aspirations, becoming
less.

title: Need to be alone
body:
I have a pattern. After being satisfied with [@M](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a), I fall into an immediate
melancholy. Today, I wanted her to leave, wanted her 80's rock to stop,
wanted her to stop touching me, didn't like the smell of her. I wanted
time alone. Now, an hour later, with her gone I am pining for [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) and
the girls, I want to return home. I want to delete my dating accounts,
close off my relationships.

I think I need to be alone to process everything. It's been six weeks
and I have spent a total of maybe 5 hours considering all that happened.
I haven't meditated since I've been here. I barely read. Every moment
has been spent with E and M.

What needs to change absolutely:

- Get out of dating-like relationship with M.

  - Stop sleeping over so much. Set a limit of 1/wk maybe.

  - Stop hanging out all the time. Maybe 3/wk dates at the most.

  - Focus on life, not sex.

Could I go back if I wanted to? What would I need:

- Find a strong identity in myself.

- Change the decor.

- Keep accounts separate.

- Continue with divorce (don't let her have future money -- or sign a
  postnup). As I think about divorce or postnup, it occurs to me that
  my identity is attached, my self-worth in a way to being a husband.
  I want to be a good husband. I feel ashamed, selfish, to not support
  her and be committed to her.

  - What relationship would this leave me then? Me unwilling to ever
    leave, to always support? In the past, this meant that I ate
    shit. But what needs to happen is that I continually make my
    desires and needs known.

    - "Jen, I need to feel not taken for granted. Will you tell me
      how grateful you are for my love?"

    - "Jen, I need to feel admired. Will you verbalize when you
      feel fond of me and when you think highly of me?"

    - "Jen, I need to feel desired. Will you ..."

    - "Jen, I need to feel supported. Will you rub my back when I
      look weary?"

- Give up sex or open up the relationship.

- Accept that:

  - Jen's body will continue to not allow her to do much of anything
    physical.

  - Jen will continue to be a demisexual.

  - Jen and I will continue to not be spiritually aligned.

  - I will continue to represent oppression to Jen.

  - I won't be entirely seen by Jen.

```{=html}
<!-- -->
```

- I don't want to be responsible for another. Or do I?

- Find a way to follow my own north star with love and being

- Find a mission that I care about and get absorbed in it.

- Rereading this on 3/2/2023. I have since simplified all of this as
  "Jen didn't love me well". Mav is incredible at making me feel
  desired and respected and engaging with my pursuits all while taking
  responsibility for herself. Jen, on the other hand, barely wanted to
  spend time with me, tore me down all the time, and spent all my
  resources.

What I would give up:

- Fucking M.
- My apartment.

Need to:

- Eat right
- Exercise
- Sleep
- Work
- Write/think
- Relate: but how? I want friends and comrades, but am tired of
  fucking.

title: Longing and loss
body:
Like detoxing a drug. Frantic. Need to be with her, to connect, angry
that she won't, that she left. Try to go on a long walk. Try to breathe.
Something about impermanence helps. But also makes me lose interest in
anything. I don't see beauty, I just see grass, sound, sun, bird,
person. Tried to read Whitman's Song of Myself, but he just seems like a
whacko to me right now. How can one love without possessing? What's the
point of anything? Sex feels pointless. Exploration feels pointless.
Travel. Dating. Politics. Programming. Nothing moves me as I'm longing
to hold her, to be with her.

The only thing I know to do is wait. Stop smoking. Move again. Eat well.
Sleep. Breathe.

Noticeably, I don't want to run to [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) in my loneliness. I spent a good
deal of time considering whether we can live openly... whether a home
base would be a nice thing... but I just feel nothing from her. I think
I just want her to take my guilt away.
