title: (Mav back from SB)
body:
Picked [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) from the airport and dropped her off to let her settle in for
a few hours before possibly intense conversations on the way to
rockzilla. She chose to go get a drink with [@Phil](person:520138a2-a693-433f-ab2d-0fbe191ece6a) in that time and texted
me the song "Real Life" by Story of the Yea . It's about being with
someone who is passionate but makes you want to commit suicide. I texted
her 6 mesgs explaining where I'm at now and why it's not suicide, but
liberation. She read just the first before meeting Phil.

If she goes for Phil we can't be friends... because she chose him before
breaking off with me. She did it by getting a drink with him alone, then
now by talking to him before me.

My hope is that she is telling him she needs to see it through with me.

I want her, but I'll be fine. I'm learning to really love myself and my
life.

I sit here drinking at [@Buckleys](location:a2924cc8-234e-4e5f-a515-d64d53573752). Waiting for her to come over to my
place at 3. Waiting, just like I did with [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c), my wife, and [@Brent](person:4e670761-2a77-4bb3-bdc6-c26a04f263e5). And
I'm ok. I feel myself now.

Mav said she wasn't even into Phil in any way remotely close to what she
feels with me. This has to be her cleaning up and making me pay a bit.
If not, she was always a liar on some level. If not, all her expressions
of desire were about keeping me and not me. In that case, she was really
great, but not worthy of a love life with me. I dodged a bullet.

But if she comes for me, it means she might be a partner anyone would
cherish... someone willing to love themselves and ask for you to meet
their needs, and do their all to meet yours.

I'll find out in 20 minutes.

title: (Cairde Pub blowup)
body:
Cairde Pub. All I wanted to fucking do last night was journal a little
bit, and I'm getting up at 6am with a headache and bloated stomach at
6am to do it now. [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) was a piece of work. Again. So much fucking drama.
She didn't really text all day which was unusual. She started her period
which should have been helpful... her PMDD that causes her to have
suicidal ideation should have been ebbing. She had been researching
vacations for us, said she wanted to pay for me to go to a conference in
[@Tulum](location:05fea7f2-a27a-4ff6-879d-dcc7db284ec7), was going to go to [@Austin](location:9227587e-a519-48f5-a864-36121da3a894) for a week next week even though \$700
tickets. I spoke of how the conference wouldn't totally be my thing, but
Austin sounded like a lot of fun. I talked about SAIS possibilities, and
she got weird about it and wouldn't really explain. Mostly though, she
just looked panicked, with pursed lips and wide eyes and low affect and
hesitant touch. She kept saying she was fine, started blaming the lack
of energy on me, I acquiesced and moved to open my laptop to journal
(finally), and she got the check... so fucking dramatic. I walk her the
block home and hop on a scooter... she calls five times telling me to
come back... I Telegram her when I get home and spend _another_ thirty
minutes trying to calm her anxiety.

This is too much of my life.

It's not worth it.

I was going to journal about Jen and her and what I want. I was
considering telling Mav I was fine with dating but didn't want to be her
life partner. This shit makes it easy.

She's not malicious. She's not stable. This really isn't my job to try
to stabilize another woman. I just can't.

Almost two months ago, I resolved to take a chance with intimacy and
date Mav, knowing that if it didn't work out I can back out. At the
time, these were my concerns:

- _I'm sorry your back is keeping you bedridden. I want to keep
  supporting you, but I also need to keep active. Do you mind if I go
  hiking with X this weekend? I'll check in and bring you back more
  meds and we'll have a snuggling time on Monday._

- _I noticed you haven't been into me for awhile and haven't wanted
  rough/risky/novel sex like we used to. I really want those things.
  Can we try to get to the bottom of what has changed for you? Would
  you be willing to try X on Saturday? "_

- _" you've been preoccupied with the stress around your work for the
  past two weeks. I love supporting you around this, but I also miss
  how we used to go out and really play. I was hoping to play tonight.
  Do you think we can switch lanes right now and. Reconnect here and
  now? "_

- _I know you get really anxious thinking I'm going to abandon you for
  [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c). I want you to know you're my girl. And you mean the world to
  me. I want to be with you, not her. She never loved me the way you
  do all the time and I'm not looking to start that up with her again.
  I need you to understand, though, that a lot of our past is precious
  to me, and staying connected is important to me... my kids, of
  course, but also treasuring the good moments and growth and
  challenging each other to be better people. She's a good friend, and
  it's i..._

Now I know her so much better. My concerns are different:

- You want a husband without the ring or child, I don't want that.

- You are physically and mentally unwell and I don't want to sign up
  for that. One week of every month you are a disaster. Every Sunday
  you are a disaster. To this day you haven't gone for help on either
  of those issues. You're afraid you'll be committed.

- You are suicidal.

- You've expressed several times with no ambiguity, something about us
  takes you to a dark place. You say you need to move.

- You have no friends. Your sister needs an intervention.

Uff. And she's put the following thoughts into the air in the past eight
weeks:

- We fit or we don't. We shouldn't try to change one another (in
  response to me communicating about needs).

- She's not good enough for me.

- We're just dating, no need to be intense, if it doesn't work it
  doesn't work.

- I'm the only friend she has, having apartment possessions is the
  only thing keeping her from killing herself, she fucks everything
  up, she's ugly and stupid.

So, it's this. She is mentally unwell (primarily due to abuse from her
father), I trigger her (probably because I'm old and a father), I can't
determine how much of her attraction is really for me.

Good sex and someone capable who adores me is not worth this.

What I _wanted_ to be considering last night is my relationship with
Jen. Two talks into three or four... she says loves me so much and wants
to show it to me. We talk about regrets and disappointments, how it
ended and why, and money. She continues to claim it was all just about
to get so good. When I'm in the house, with [@Sinead](person:72a05873-c2c7-4de6-b5e2-ae6c2abcf2d3), I just want to be
there. It feels so simple, so easy. I want to go back, but I'm not sure
I can stomach the Jen... the manipulation, instability, egoism,
fairy-tale approaches, and supplements.

But perhaps the separation and what I've learned since make this
plausible? Am I able to maintain autonomy while making that my home? If
not, is she worth being a friend to? I not, are there things that could
be said now that will be gifts to one another as we part? Do I have any
topics I'd like to discuss with her re: reconciliation? Sure:

- Hmmm... can't really think of any. Mostly I just feel like I want to
  be done with both of these women right now.

title: Sat (Offer Mav the world. Then text goodbye)
body:
Sent about 50 texts back and forth to [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) yesterday. Promised her the
moon. Real partnership. She said it was a dream but didn't trust me. I
said she could trust our therapists, too. Never replied to that last
one.

Paid \$99 for a how-to-get-him-back course and listened to it. It told
me to not do what I was doing (begging). Instead, it said to write
something like this, which I did. And then don't reach out for at least
21 days. They seem to be assuming that it is unlikely they'll find
another partner within that time, so not totally my situation. But I
guess it comes down to whether she misses me when she is with [@Phil](person:520138a2-a693-433f-ab2d-0fbe191ece6a), and
she can't miss me while I'm begging, so here goes.

Text to Mav at 1pm: _Ok, Mav, I get it. I gave it all I had. Thanks for
unpacking things with me. It will help me be a better man the next time
around. Maybe it could have never worked chasing a divorce and a breakup
like we did. Despite how things ended, I will always remember the past
nine months. They were some of the best of my life. I'll always
remember lying in the grass with you in the sculpture garden, watching
the wind blow through your hair as you stood up through my sun roof,
sweating wrapped around you all night, [@Carolina](location:cd01680f-ad4c-4b8c-8dff-54388fd6a51c), running under
streetlights, and all the dreaming and hustling. Take care of yourself.
I'll always thank the best of you. Good luck with everything. Your
companion for a while, Paul._

There's actually something quite freeing about writing this. I don't
miss her as much knowing she is gone. I still haven't eaten since... I
don't know. But that's for me, for change. I walked to [@REI](organization:9569b5da-fc22-419e-ac53-f1d92e3b5311) and got some
running and hiking shoes. I've decided to start a social club. I was
thinking about changing my name.

Poker night. 5 guys. It was nice. I just wished Mav was there the whole
time.

title: Sat (First connection after breakup)
body:
Yesterday I finally got to see her and hold her again for a minute.

On June 1 (Thu) at 3:52pm I sent her this text "Some days I feel strong
and like I'm going to be alright. But today I feel like there's no
light left in my life without you.", then "let me love you" which
instigated a full day of texting back and forth with her saying she
tried and I didn't love her and me saying I loved her dearly but was
rebounding off [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) and had issues, and she had issues of running away
instead of talking about us. Ended with:

[@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a): Last night I fell asleep. I'm overwhelmed by all this and it's
triggering a lot of anxiety again. I wish I could comfort you. I have to
step away again.

[@Payne](person:0b085c55-5431-4cd4-89d1-af1bf1b5e817): You don't have to. There are other ways to deal with your
anxiety. Courage, trust, communication, love. Not running away, not
distraction. This right here is the real reason we don't work.

Payne: We could have had support. We could have worked through it all by
now.

Payne: You're so afraid of being hurt if you fall for me again you're
running away. You ran all the way to the finish line and are too afraid
to see if it's true.

Payne: I'm not even asking you to cross the line with me. I'm asking
to go to go therapy with me. An opportunity to deal with anxiety in a
healthy way, put to rest what happened, and clear the board for what is
or isn't next.

Mav: :( I am very over stimulated right now. I need a hug :(

Paul: I would totally give you a hug of course. I hugged a pillow and
bawled for an hour on Tue. I imagined it was my small young self that
needed me to love him.

Paul: Want me to jog over there now?

Mav: No no it's okay

Mav: Your young self deserved so much more love than he got

Paul: I know. But I would. But I know. This stimulation isn't something

title: Feeling the pain
body:
November!

Today and yesterday have been a trip. Quitting smoking makes my body
freak the fuck out. The dopamine desire is ridiculously clear... an
internal screaming for satisfaction. I, the "watcher" has been laughing
my head off at how clearly child-like it is, how "id". At the same time,
I gain more energy, so it's a strange mix of feeling good and feeling
awful. Went through pictures of [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) last night wondering how much I love
her, also wondering if I can take the pain of looking at her. Listened
to Blink-182's album and coffee house today was playing a bunch of
pop-punk. The feelings of heartache washed through with the nicotine
withdrawal, and I just experience waves of hilarity---like "fine, fuck
it, do your worst"---and recognizing that I'm ok, that feelings aren't
so scary, I don't have to avoid them. Went for a long walk around the
harbor, laugh-cried for half of it... feeling the pain, realizing I was
ok, letting it wash through. Is this what they mean when they say it's
not good trying to avoid the feelings, you just need to feel them. It
makes me want to listen to all the songs, watch romance movies, is this
what chicks have figured out? Cuz after the crying, I feel better for a
while.

At the same time, I feel grateful for the guidance of these feelings.
They tell me something true about what I like, and what I fear.

Why not give myself permission to feel it all, pursue what I desire,
ignore some feelings, pursue others. What are the difference? Their
prescription lies, but their desire doesn't.

Smoking: I want regulated dopamine. I want to feel good (don't need
cigarettes, though)

Heartbreak fear: I want someone (don't need Mav, though).

I can tell this is somewhat on point because I felt, for a moment, like
I did when I was a kid, like leaving work after a day of
anti-depressants... _life is safe, all options, super fun._

So, what does giving myself permission look like?

- It means booking a trip to [@Tokyo](location:a6608bab-d91d-4513-9d3c-bcd79d9b5e02).

- It means making art.

- It means reading interesting things.

- It means writing.

- It means giving myself time to program.

- It means getting strong. Getting healthy.

- It means chasing what I find beautiful. Following the people I like,
  not the people I feel like I owe something to.

- It means feeling whether I like things or not, and bringing them
  into my life if I do... music, clothes, people.

- Just pursuing Mav, because I want to, and because I should do
  absolutely everything to get what I want. But knowing I don't _need
  her_, because my life is full of what I want.

**Do everything you can to get what you want. Why not? What else are you
going to spend your life doing?**

title: Need of Mav
body:
Today I feel like I _need_ [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a). I can't focus without her. Everything
seems meaningless without her. There's a person out there who is just
like me, and we understand each other and we love each other (at least I
thought she loved me) and I can't get to her, I can't be with her.

It's more than desire, which we have. It's more than support. It feels
like something existential.

Every encounter with some other woman leaves me empty, but even the
slightest interaction with Mav fills something in me.

Is this co-dependency?

Today, I can't stop imagining how I might win her back. The best idea I
have is to work at the coffee place next to her work until she comes and
talks with me. And then to tell her "I need you". It's a hail Mary...
banking everything on the hope that she has continued to think about me,
to miss me.

Now, I think of texting her, "Life is meaningless without you".

What drove me here? Perhaps a hope that being in [@San Diego](location:5e412cfd-6b01-4367-85fd-9082dd93345b), changing my
environment completely, would free me. And then finding that it didn't.
No amount of separation will. I must deal with this one way or another.

But it always comes to this: she didn't want me in [@Indiana](location:95c3fe40-b0d7-4934-9e7b-c6453682d650). She wanted
[@Max](person:059c7d9a-358e-483a-a9a3-4dce5820c47a). But did she? I need to know. I need to know if she's unavailable or
just not reached.

And it comes to this: I felt suffocated. The confusion, the fear of
committing, I can understand. But at times, and perhaps with everyone, I
just felt tired... I needed to be depressed... to have time on my own...
to think and to center. But I don't always feel this way, just when I
get tired, off. I want her to be there when I return.

I'm so lost.

So despairing. So sad.

Why can't I get my shit together?

There's a gaping hole of love inside me that she filled, and I've found
no other who ever came close. The theory is that it's a big sea, lots of
fish... but each time I love another, it falls so, so short. The love
she gave me wasn't just need... every woman has needed me to be
something... it was reciprocal. I needed her, too. I needed to be a
savior, a protector of something precious. Protecting her gave my life
meaning.

I needed someone to connect me with wonder and delight and discovery...
the quest for more.

And she was so, so sexy. I felt embarrassed to be with her thinking of
other people wondering why she was with me. I was ashamed feeling I was
a lecherous old man. I didn't feel like I was enough for her. But she
needed that from me, too, to feel desired, needed, wanted. How can two
people in love feel like they're not worthy of one another? What kind of
black magic is this? To be seen as sexy by someone you feel is out of
your league.

So does another exist? Someone out of my league who desires me? Someone
I need who needs me? Someone who brings out the beauty in me that I long
for?

title: Pining for connection
body:
- [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) returned last week and I've texted her a few times to see if she
  wants to grab a coffee, to be friends. She doesn't want to. I want
  to stop thinking about her.

- Focus on taste, career, health.

What is this inability to be content with myself and my own experience
of life, to be ever pining for connection with someone else to give me
purpose, to feel like my day wasn't wasted. I see what's happening, the
classic marshmallow test: instead of focusing on creating a better life
for myself, a context for which truly great experiences might form, I
panic and clutch at any scrap offered in front of me. Instead of
creating a banquet, I stuff marshmallows in my face.

These past months of dating, what did they accomplish? A confidence that
sex is available to me. A confidence that I can create experiences with
others. I met a beautiful person whom I am not really physically
attracted to, and who I can't seem to please sexually. What did I
accomplish with Mav? A recognition of how desperate I am for fun, to
feel powerful in pleasing a woman sexually. I admired her hustling. I
admired her kindness (until she wasn't---a very surface kindness). These
relationships did not make me happier. They did make me fuller, maybe
like a bad mushroom trip.

Things that do make me happy are knowing I am safe---physically,
emotionally, relationally; knowing I am a valued member of a community,
feeling like I am mature, capable, living well---strongly... making a
positive impact.

I am so fucking dysregulated right now. Almost panicking, anxiety,
feeling alone, like nobody is there for me, nobody can understand me,
nobody can help. I feel so existentially alone. I keep thinking these
thoughts will help, but where are they now?:

- How can we be alone if we are a part of everything?

- Every love I've received or given is a part of my heart.

- One can't predict the future.

- I can love my inner child. Is it me that's feeling dysregulated, or
  him?

The truth is that any interaction with Mav (like asking her to get a cup
of coffee with me like I did earlier today) dysregulates me intensely.
Or its the cancer removal, post-COVID, hungover, nicotine withdrawal,
preparing to move. Can I really tell? Yeah, reading now, it appears that
dopamine levels are reduced by 15-20% when stopping smoking and return
to normal production in about THREE MONTHS! Ok... when did I stop? Right
around the 13^th^. 11 weeks left. ☹Meditation and exercise apparently
help boost dopamine, so let's get that going, too.

title: Imagining Mav from the start
body:
Let's imagine [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) at the beginning: "I have debilitating anxiety every
Sunday and for about 4-7 days a month I slip into major depression to
the point of thinking of killing myself. I am nearly physically disabled
due to an untreated back damage from an accident. I won't get
professional help and instead live through nearly continuous pain and
anxiety treating myself with bottles of ibuprofen, traction, large
amounts of alcohol, and avoiding quiet and being alone. I am highly
capable at anything I do because I've learned to power through the fear
even though it wears me down physically and psychically. I don't know
how much more I can hold on. I'm still psychically traumatized from a
physically, mentally, and sexually abusive father. I want a father
figure, someone who will take care of me but allow me to be independent.
I have my own money. On the upside, I'm smoking hot and I will do just
about any sexual thing with you as long as it doesn't conflict with my
fear of disease. If you'll take care of me, I'll love you. I like text
messages throughout the day as I am distracted by my anxiety and feel
connected to you when you are sharing all your thoughts and allow me to
do the same. I would like to spend every moment possible with you,
ideally all weekend and every possible evening."

No thanks.

Later. [@SAIS](organization:83e05a17-9aec-42ee-9454-57160f996b05). Lame. Left early and Telegram'd this to Mav:

_Mav,_

_You said "I'm grateful for the many fun times we've shared", but that
doesn't nearly capture it for me. I'm so grateful for you for so many
reasons._

_Meeting you changed my life. You're probably the most beautiful person
I've ever met. In a world of corporate zombies and fake people, people
who've just given up, you're a light. You shine as a soul refusing to
be satisfied with shallow relationships, with trudging through life half
awake, with not being willing to dream big._

_You want everything to be delightful, fun. My first moments of getting
to know you were finding someone who still had a curiosity and wonder
about life... wondering how to break the cycles, to reawaken your
heart, to desire. You ran around town at night with me, brought Mod Sun
streetlights to life, wrote stories about gas cans and portals. You made
me feel young again, made me feel excited to be alive again._

_I felt so undesirable, unloved when I met you. You slowly, consistently
made me feel lovable again. You made me feel attractive again. You
showed me that my desire could be met and I could be desired back. You
touched me, calmed me, lit me up, drove me wild._

_You brought me Camu... made me grapple with Atlas and come to terms
with the dual nature of pushing the boulder and still finding happiness.
You turned me onto Rand again, and reminded me that it's ok to be
selfish, to not be burdened by everyone else's entitlements and
society's demands for normative self-nullification. It's ok to want
and to go after it._

_You gave me an example of someone who still grappled with expressing
themselves and was unwilling to just be like everyone else... your
imagery with MidJourney, finding your style, unabashed joy at pop-punk
and rock and Picolo. I'm so grateful how you shared your journals with
me, your struggles and triumphs of becoming human and finding your way
in the world. So very like me._

_Your heart for people is transformative. You make me want to be a
better human. You always see things through the eyes of those who suffer
most in the world, you advocate for their struggles, and yet you refuse
to let their pain break you. Your everyday kindness with everyone you
meet, especially, has made me want to be... just... kind. You always
encourage me to just make people's moments a bit better._

_And "many fun times" doesn't begin to capture how grateful I am for
all our adventures. I feel like I lived a life with you in months.
Silent disco, [@Smith Tower](location:2c74f886-1cd9-4fab-b344-f54f49aa4c6b), sex house, Mariners and Sounders and Kraken
games, a monster truck rally, dive bars in [@Sultan](location:84de30d0-ae79-4e79-bd91-580a67a56ce9), the best New Years
Eve view in the city, writing our names in concrete, competitive darts
and pinball and basketball and Beat Saber (and Bumble likes), the best
shows\--Kate the Great, community, Idiocracy, the best drinking buddy
ever with your sister and the crew,, so many cards._

_And I'm so grateful for all the gifts you gave me... a massive bottle
of nice whiskey, an electric boat ride in the apocalypse, a posh weekend
at the [@Four Seasons](location:650d86e8-a7ca-4106-83d1-0f67e1e89574), a tiny bottle of Tabasco, fancy drinks behind
locked doors._

_And I'm grateful how you built things with me... careers, societies,
philosophies, dreams._

_I'm so grateful for you, Mav. You're precious to me. I get that we
can't be partners. I expect you're already making plans to move to
[@Austin](location:9227587e-a519-48f5-a864-36121da3a894). But I hope you'll still be in my life. I hope we will still be
friends, maybe companions of some kind. And if not, I wanted you to at
least know how deeply grateful I am for knowing you, and will always be.
I miss you._

title: Let go of pain
body:
A bathtub reflection:

Party yells could be oblivion or could be living in love. Being with
could be in fear of not pleasing or joy of being with. Because of
neglect, loving for me has always been about pleasing. If, though, I
drop that fear, that external expectation and instead I choose to love
out of expression, well then I'm not looking for someone who might love
me back, I'm looking for someone who can take my expression and dance
with me.

Can I let go of the pain from not being loved? Can I let go of the story
that it was my fault? Can I embrace the idea that the world is full of
love waiting to be given just as I am?

[@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) performs even more than me. Unlike me, she needs someone to distract
her from her terrors. Terror of being unlovable.

I reread our text messages and it wrecked me. What I was saying at the
time seemed to persuasive. But when I reread it just seems like
low-value drivel.... like I was just making up what she wanted to hear.
Of course she didn't trust me.

Ran this morning for the first time. Went to meditation at 11. Sitting
at a Uptown now working on SAIS and Bright Lights Social Club (working
title). It seems like this all should help, but I just want Mav with me
at all of them.

adventures ahead.

Your parents did a number on you. Your schools reinforced it.

title: Don't get into a relationship until healed
body:
Things I learned about life and love when I was 48.

- Don't get into a relationship until you've healed from the last.
  It's not fair to the new lover.

- Know what you want in your life. Fun? Friend? Sex? Love?

- Beware the insecure. They will bleed you. You'll want to escape.
  They create their own misery.

- There's no replacement to being happy with just yourself. Doing
  things you're excited about is important. Having attainable goals.
  Dreams.

- Attraction compatibility is important. I am intoxicated by tiny
  women with small waists and long hair. The right attraction will
  cause shivers at the slightest touch.

- Don't say "I hate romance"

- Being with a woman who isn't transparent about her feelings is a
  dead end. It can't possibly work.

- If someone fundamentally believes they are existentially alone and
  cant be understood... they're telling you they'll never feel
  understood.

- [@Camu](person:e6bbca04-3dce-4120-acce-6abee4b58329) and [@Nietzsche](person:c90fc4eb-367e-4eb9-b67b-a249bd35830b) were sad boyz trapped in their European
  historical context who had no understanding of eastern philosophy
  which would have freed them from much of their existential dread.

- Career is important. It opens opportunity. You're not retiring, yet.

- The fear of being alone is terrifying but likely overblown. There
  are beautiful people out there. I have to believe it. I've lived in
  a bubble.

- Smell is everything.

- Love, love, love.

- Lead. Set a direction.

- Speak. Give voice. Obsessive thoughts point you towards an action
  you aren't taking, a thing you're not saying.

- Not all things need to be said, divulged. Choose what you want. Say
  what achieves your end. Otherwise, you'll regret what and how you
  said. Some people don't want to work your thoughts out with you,
  they will overweight your words and make you pay for not being
  clear. These people don't love you, they need you.

- There is a difference between love and need. Love is kind, gracious,
  forgiving, wants your best. Need requires performance, constant
  validation, and is inherently anxiety inducing.

- Needy people may not love you at all.

- It's best to avoid being in relationship with needy people. Love
  them as souls, but don't expect them to be able to love in return.

- Good friends will look out for you. It's an "tide lifts all boats"
  mentality. Same in networking. They'll have your back, give you
  access to opportunities. Be a good friend.

- Networking is like having a good circulatory system.

- Tell people they are important to you, why they are special.

- Being adored is waaaayyyyy too intoxicating if you don't adore
  yourself and are looking for external validation. Adore yourself,
  [@Paul](person:0b085c55-5431-4cd4-89d1-af1bf1b5e817).

- Speak generatively, hopefully, with an vision of beauty Eliminate
  passive aggression... no withholding, no threats, no creating a
  picture of bad consequences.

- Don't date someone from work. If your heart is broken, memories of
  the office will haunt you and you won't be able to get away from
  them.

- Don't drink more than one whiskey a night, it is the most depressing
  alcohol.

- Smoking will keep you from exercising.

- Exercising regularly brings you energy and positive view of self.

- Loving is circular. Receive it and give it back. Repeat.

- Let people help you.

- Just because something worked in a past relationship doesn't mean it
  will work in a new one. Just because something was tolerated in a
  previous relationship doesn't mean it will be tolerated in a new
  one.

title: Intent to express differences
body:
Intent: Get together with girls for a thanksgiving meal and express these things
(talking points):

- They are both adults. They can do what the world tells them or do
  what they decide. Community doesn't absolve them from the
  responsibility to make their own choices of how they want to live in
  this world. They need to choose who they spend their time with, what
  they spend their time on, how they will contribute to society.

- [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) and I have different approaches to life. We both have curiosity
  and both dream, but have different approaches.

  - Jen

    - She is selfish. Not wanting do anything she didn't want to
      (be married, spend time with friends, work, have kids). She
      did the same personally, depending on me to provide for her
      and support her wishes, with no recognition of my own
      desires (to be financially secure, to have friends, to be
      logical).

    - She is obstinate and inflexible and unreasonable. She
      believes only what she wants to. Her choices destroyed her
      health. She has no faith in anyone but herself. She refuses
      to believe evidence that contradicts her.

    - She is independent, solitary. She does not collaborate, she
      cogitates. She seeks out people who reinforce her viewpoints
      ([@Mars Hill](organization:27b5f958-1cf2-40f5-b096-d50e60759571), woo woo community), but refuses to contribute to
      their community. Her only community is that which she can
      control to get what she wants. Same as her uncle.

    - She is negative. The world is full of threat. Everything is
      someone else's fault. She has no power. She wishes the world
      were different and refuses to participate. She narrows her
      scope. She destroys the good that exists for the dream that
      doesn't. She is a defeatist that retreats into her shell.

    - She undermined my relationship with them was compromised
      starting in high-school as I sought to teach them about
      science and work and personal and social engagement, to get
      them the tools to compete (she coddled you).

  - Me

    - I am autonomous, not independent. I want my own power and
      control so I don't have to be subjugated.

    - I believe in the scientific endeavor and the ability to
      create a better society.

    - The world is full of wonder and potential. We are improving
      as a species but it takes effort and engagement (not just
      complaining or checking out).

    - we need to work within the constraints of the world we find
      ourselves. Careers, jobs, relationships. We need to work
      with others to change the world. Every generation has been
      confronted with this task. We are dependent on the system we
      find ourselves in. I am a dreamer and and engager. We can
      only engage in the areas we have influence. We need to
      increase our scope of influence and make change where we can
      (ethical use of AI, AI community, technology, ethics).

  - Us

    - She never wanted to be married. She could never find a way
      to reconcile her feelings of the patriarchy, of feeling
      controlled, with a relationship with me. She demanded
      accommodation while refusing to accommodate in return. I
      allowed myself to be silenced.

    - She refused to engage, using her health or external factors
      (oppression) as excuses. She undermined my engagements,
      attacked my values, sabotaged our relationships. She
      believed she was right in every regard and that I was wrong.
      She condescended my contributions to our family. It was
      always my fault that she wasn't "in love" with me. I asked
      her to change, but she refused. She refused marital
      counseling when it conflicted with her desires.

- See me: I will continue to seek ways to change systemic ills using
  technology. I will continue to engage more with the world through
  travel and collaboration. I want a partner who believes in me and
  will support me. I have a relationship with [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a).

- For them:

  - I believe in you both. I see you are figuring out what to
    believe about the world and you're doing great.

  - You've lost much hope. You need to regain it. You are
    responsible for maintaining your hope and not allowing yourself
    to sink into despair. Get off social media. There is much bad in
    the world, but much good, too. Like every generation, you can be
    part of the problem or part of the solution.

  - I know the idea of their family has changed. From nuclear to
    dispersed. But it's ok. You have what you need and your mom and
    I will always back you up.

  - You have the ability to make a difference. You don't change the
    world by disengaging with it. You need to find your passions and
    choose how to spend your life.

  - You need to continue to develop yourselves to contribute. This
    means personally (physical and mental health, ethics, financial
    freedom, and capabilities) and socially (your associations).
    Educate yourself. Equip yourself. Do more with what you've been
    given. Refine your skills. Don't do it alone. Find good people
    to collaborate with and be a good team player to magnify your
    impact.

  - Corporations are not inherently evil. Some (like non-profits,
    beneficial corps) are directly making the world a better place.
    Even for-profits are filled with principled people. Good and bad
    exist everywhere. Don't be reductionist.

- It would be nice if we can check in once and awhile.

build something, to create relationships with professionals... the
willingness to find a community, someone special and right to experience
life with. It's so easy for me to exchange my own aspirations for life
for the hope of someone else loving me. I feel the temptation, but I'm
not doing that with Mav. We imagine living: Hey Simone, travel,

I need to make time for the things that are important to me. [@Fiona](person:40f1bbfa-f375-4a65-84d9-1290fd02a3c7)

judgementalism, fake empowerment, anxiety. I don't actually respect [@Miss](person:169122ae-a437-42c6-bec9-14309c4c35cc)

neediness (I am magical, I know the future, you need me).

What do I want to pass onto them? As [@Konstantin](person:be69bae2-96ff-4595-92a6-a831c8bec010) says, what do I need
from Jen for me to create the relationship I need with them? (not a
lot). What does living most fully look like? How can I show them,
support them?

First, stop allowing past mistakes from keeping me from living fully
now. I don't own Jen some sort of continued sadness or grief. I owe her
rage.

Then... more money, more love, more friends, more adventures, a
community that I want to invest in, projects that are meaningful,
safety, beauty.

It's hard to live in this world, being so connected. Maybe [@Jaron](person:94b54a3d-4f56-44bb-af09-9b8d4e367189) is
right and we just really all need to get off social media. Really,
though, maybe a non-manipulation-engined version is what we need... to
communicate with communities without the feed. Maybe that is actually
the main thing to work on... not AI.

title: Why I need connection
body:
Why do I want a woman in my life? I would need to balance them with me.
Me: focusing on my career, my contribution, and my health. Them: their
needs and desires.

What is a successful career and contribution without good times? What
are good times without sharing? They make the good times rewarding...
seeing their joy and pleasure. Companionship. Gratitude. Love.

I want to feel connected to the cosmos. Through touch. By being seen.
Less like a ghost. Less alone.

But it's more than this... I could have this with [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c), no? Maybe she
didn't see me. She didn't show gratitude. Love.

I still can't believe [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) left me. I underestimated her fragile psyche.
She needed me to care for her more. I didn't know our relationship, the
promise it held, to create such fear of losing it. I didn't know the
fear caused more anguish than actually losing it.

[@Hozier](person:a6110f50-15c1-4b11-a6a4-ff689cb85f9b) is playing at the stadium next door right now. It sounds
beautiful and moving. I don't want to hear it without someone. But with
someone here with me, I'd pour a glass of wine, light a candle and take
it in. Doing so would be adding another experience to life that I would
otherwise not have. Why do I care? What is this collection of beautiful
moments? What is the aesthetic effect on the soul? Perhaps it makes it
all worth it by reminding us of the beauty of it all. Are these things
not beautiful if not shared? Or maybe the beautiful moments are just too
painful right now, because it reminds me of the one I shared them with.
Perhaps someday I'll feel able to go outside and experience beauty on my
own again.

...

It's important to:

- Remember your body: dance, yoga, sex, feelings of love, meditation

- Connect: sex, feelings of love, time

- Remember why humanity is special: art, events, travel, movies, music

- Sharpen

title: Demons and deeper drive
body:
Demons drive. It is tempting to credit our demons with our success, and
this is true, but it's not the whole story. If it were, every
traumatized person would be a luminary. The greatest luminaries
experienced the most personal trauma. Yet one of 100,000 traumatized
persons becomes a luminary. It is infinitely more likely for our demons
to devour us in addiction or obsession or fear than propel us.
Luminaries harness their demons.

The rest of the story is connecting to a deeper drive that is the true
source of their success. Those who win have a beauty within them to hold
fast to a vision of a different world and courage to take risks in the
face of violence. They have some unflagging advocacy of self that says
no to power. These characteristics did not come from demons, they came
from the soul. Demons exercised these qualities, purifying them in the
crucible, but they did not create them.

In the face of my demons, I did not connect to this deeper drive.
Instead, I resolved them. But my resolution, at the same time,
eliminated my drive. I sacrificed my will to impact the world for
equanimity. I soon became discontent, feeling as though I lost a part of
myself that I treasured.

What is needed is not to set impact and equanimity into opposition, but
to bring equanimity to the will for impact. The greatest luminaries
transformed their _need_ for impact into being an expression of their
deeper nature. They found a way to resolve their demons and express
their nature.

Let me be clear. Wu wei is becoming one with nature. This nature, in
luminaries, is not isolation, but a desire to catalyze change. I accept
my demons honed the glorious parts of me into some form of success, but
they did not create those glorious parts. The equanimity I seek is to be
found by giving those glorious parts expression from a place of flow,
not a place of need.

Perhaps this is all a way of saying I am happiest when I am making an
impact and that's ok.

\>\>\>

I want adventures. I'm tired of limiting my expression. I want to allow
myself to express loudly and whole-heartedly.

title: Hate and miss
body:
I don't want to hate [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c).

Could it have ever worked with her?

- She didn't want to love me like I needed. To admire me. To respect
  me.
- I was never enough for her. She always complained.
- She belittled me, said I wasn't enough for our children.
- She wanted me to stay, but how could I? I would have never been able
  to meet someone who loved me well, like [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a).

So what is left?

- Staying would have meant I never had a love that worked for me.
- I miss her, though... or I miss the hope that I held onto for so
  long... missed what might have been.
- I miss her smile. I miss the moments we were happy... grounded...
  with the home... and the girls.
- But our dreams were out of line. Our desires were out of line. I
  feel so distraught that we were unaligned. I wanted physical
  affection. I wanted physical desire. I wanted fun. I wanted
  exploration of my interests (travel, civics, philosophy, business).
  I am so distraught that she never wanted them. What does it mean to
  want to be with someone while everything is unaligned? I wanted her
  to be different. She wanted me to be different. These feelings of
  mine make no sense. How could I want to be with her? What is this
  part of me that wants to be with her now? This part of me remembers
  the feeling of being aligned with her against the world... our
  bubble... the quiet... the calm... being at peace. Being where I
  "belong". Having a role. Having an identity. The dad. The husband.
  The guy who is always there. The rock. The comforter. The provider.
  But why am I ok with this when I was so dismissed, so unseen, so
  un-reciprocated. She didn't believe in marriage.
- I keep imagining if I was with her like I am with Mav she would have
  been happy... and that that is then somehow my fault. But the reason
  I wasn't like I am now is because she wasn't like Mav. I experience
  my love making an impact and it feels good. I just so wish and am so
  angry that Jen wasn't like Mav is now. And I would be so angry with
  Mav now if she were to reject my love, to betray me. Jen betrayed me
  and my love with [@Tip](person:29fba4bf-23c6-494b-ac0c-24807071f741), with [@Brent](person:4e670761-2a77-4bb3-bdc6-c26a04f263e5), with her religion. She was always
  fighting something that wasn't me. She left me alone so much, didn't
  care for my heart. Yes, the patriarchy made me not accept comfort
  from her... in some ways... but really, she just didn't comfort me.
  She didn't leave room for my insecurities, my weaknesses, my growth.
  She complained and attacked, never helped.
- So why do I want to be in relationship with her now? Because of the
  identity? The role? It's Christmas season, and I'm used to the
  traditions, even if they left me alone, they were certain. I was
  safe, but empty. A role I was familiar with with my parents. But I
  left that. Like I left now. To strike out and try to build something
  new. Alone. Regretful.

- The compassionate side:
  - I loved hard, someone who wasn't worthy of it. Someone who
    treated me like I wasn't right for her. I wasn't enough. Blamed
    me. Lied to me. Disrespected me. Took me for granted. Used me
    for my resources. She seldom acted like I was attracted to her.
    She didn't support me... always asked me to do more. In the end,
    I was doing just about everything... except the relationship
    with the kids... which she sabotaged... which is what I wanted
    and she could have supported, but didn't.
    - That's insightful, and probably why I am so mad at her now,
      calling me an absent father, still trying to get me to be
      some sort of guy who is there for her kids in the way she
      wants me to be... which seems to be more for her than for
      them.
  - I made a hard decision and was blamed for it (thrown under the
    bus).
  - Mav doesn't use me for my money, for my labor. She hopes I will
    save her. She is attracted to me.

title: Sense of timelessness
body:
Why was it so chaotic?

- I had a sense of timelessness. Like being stuck in the moment with
  everything up in the air. Every moment had massive importance, I
  couldn't distinguish between the importance of anything. Everything
  had massive consequences. I didn't know how to slow it down.

- I felt guilty for dissolving my marriage and hurting my kids. I tied
  myself to them not knowing what to do. It felt like a betrayal.

- My concept of myself was upended.

- I had never known what it was like to live on my own.

- I was flooded with endorphines.

- I was scared about my future.

- I didn't know my own taste, desires, values.

- I didn't have a boundary or a sense of agency on building my
  internal world. I let others get too in there.

title: Boundaries and love
body:
My boundaries are too open. I get to be the one who decides how my
internal world works. I require no one to make it any certain way. It is
mine. Love doesn't require the power to dictate my being. Love happens
on the outside. Transparency, yes. Control, no.

How I construct myself creates a full package that is either desired or
not. The package is the me I have to live with. It is the me I either
love, love being, or it is not. Make a being I love being. Only from
this, related.

Stop trying to get inside of other people. Stop trying to control them
to get what you want. Let them choose how to be in the world. Decide
whether what they have constructed works for you or not.

We are in a world of separation. But this is a good thing. It allows
autonomy. It asks each individual to make their choices, to realize
their values. It allows _me_ to create the life I want, to be the person
I am proud of being, to have the kind of inner world I desire. It allows
the other to be complex and mysterious, but without demanding you take
responsibility for them.

Love is not taking responsibility for one another. It is extrinsic.
People who have healthy boundaries take responsibility for themselves.

What is desire from this place of responsibility? What is love? What is
companionship? What is comfort? Healthy boundaries say "I desire you and
choose you for the work you've done in creating your beautiful self. I
see where you struggle and I will support you in the journey towards
becoming what you want to be".

title: Morning thoughts on patriarchy
body:
Morning conversations with [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a).

This morning we talked about the patriarchy as being worked through in the novel she's creating about Maria Goretti.

A few interesting points we discussed:

- The difference between privilege and complicity. As in, young Alessandro was not yet complicit, whereas older Alessandro was (he was taking on the abusive techniques of his father). Every male is privileged over others, just as a every higher hierarchy is privileged over lower. Privilege is as escapable as the hierarchy (except for those at the very very bottom--who is that?). People should not be judged for their privilege, but for their complicity. Is this what is meant by "entitlement"? The language of race seems to be an unfortunate barrier... if it could be translated to the blue collar.
- Mav reading the critique of anti-colonialists to previous generations of white feminists incepted a guilt for her needing to use the police and courts and her money to keep her safe and healthy with the incident. The anti-colonialists suggest white women going to HR is a betrayal of the cause. This perhaps confuses privilege with complicity.
- Mav connected that as "reformation" vs "revolution" of the system. Which made me immediately think of my girls. Their fatality around changing the system. Perhaps global warming caused this. Perhaps [@Black Lives Matter](organization:d32b926d-066e-4069-b187-3b9b0eeac899). There's something in the message of the anti-capitalist that breeds a fatalistic outlook.

body:

  - making assumptions
  - mind reading

---

Perhaps [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) wants a fused lover though. A sense of not being alone in her identity. That I can come in and save her from her thoughts and get her back on the trail. She gets depressed and anxious when she feels "alone" in this. Like Jen felt anxious in not having me "get her" and save her from her own feelings of purposelessness.

My ideal is a companion. Committed. Partners. But if ever our stories diverge (she wants to go be a writer, I want to make a compound with my kids, whatever) then we allow each other to move on. Not without saddness. But with well-wishing. With gratitude.

We need to both have agency.

We need to both be self-sufficient in our core. Not other-dependent.

So the question for me really is, would I give Mav up if she wants to be me-dependent and follow me around the world.

Would I give her up if I want to go in another direction that she does not want to follow.

Companions. Not parents. Not patriarchs.

Perhaps this is what Jen has been asking for us. But she is a bad companion.

So... what are my expectations of companions in this one, wild life I get to live.

title: Guilt and divorce
body:
It's been a long time since I really journaled. So much has evolved that I should fill in otherwise the following will be out of context, but I want to get what's in me out, so I'm doing that first.

There's a gulf between my old family life and this new life. I keep thinking there doesn't have to be one, but I'm not quite sure how to bridge it. I destroyed some form of family connection with my kids that I didn't need to. Some form of continuity, because I didn't know how to tease what that actually was from the idea of married life. It is a tragedy. I need to restore it for the sake of my children. I will never restore... nor do I want to... the marriage that [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) and I had. But there is something about the life we had that could be restored. What is it??

I think this is the part of me that feels like a death in some way. It's tied to a part of me that I love and that I'm intensely, deeply proud of.

[@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) needs to see that part of me if she is to know the full me.

What is it?

---

Part of the problem has been my sense of guilt. I felt guilty about ending things with Jen.

The problem with that is that I didn't want to end things with her. I wanted her to change and she wouldn't. She couldn't. I felt a sense of pride the other day, thinking of how well I _actually_ navigated the divorce in many ways... getting pre-buy-in; separating finances; softening; normalizing my schedule being disconnected; getting the divoce legally through. I saved myself. Most people would not be able to do that, and do it so well.

I should be proud.

And lying down that guilt, I enter into a more open space where I feel like I actually deserve to have the relationship with my kids and ex that I want.

title: Remote partner relationship
body:
[@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) wants to have a remote partner relationship.

[@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) wants to have a non-Married marriage relationship, which I do not
want right now. I don't want the obligation of affection and time. I
want to focus on myself and my legacy.

So, is Mav ok with a remote partner relationship or is she ok with being
a secondary in an open relationship with me and Jen? And do I want a
remote partner relationship?

A remote partner relationship would be an open relationship where the
primary partners live apart and any secondaries know they are secondary.
The primary would be ok with a high level of autonomy... no expectations
around continuous/consistent affection and time. What is the benefit of
this for me? Having a primary partner means I get the benefits of
another home, a person who knows me for years, an amount of affection
and time that works for me, and will take care of me when I'm old. Would
a secondary not do this for me? A secondary seems more like a fun
partner... even more affection and time (which I don't want).

I don't think I want a primary/secondary setup. I think I want more of a
secondary/secondary setup, or, I am my own primary as in the case of
solo polyamory.

I guess the real question is, can I be ok with saying goodbye
once-and-for-all to Jen and the home. I feel ok saying goodbye to Mav,
we don't have the history.

Do I want to be solo-polyamory (secondaries) or just solo (casual)? If
solo-polyam, Jen would be one of my amours and all other women would
need to know she is there and our relationship is just as a secondary.
If solo, my amours would need to know I am open and ...

This is all so confusing. Let's simplify. I am only into casual
dating... and infrequently. I don't want the emotional, affectionate,
time, and resource obligations of a partner. Yet my heart is still
pulled to the history that Jen and I created together. I can keep Jen
and the history, and she would be ok with me dating casually, and give
up Mav. Or I can keep Mav and give up Jen and the history and casual
dating anyone else (not worth it, it turns out). Or I can give up Jen
and the history and Mav and only casual date going forward.

- First question, do I want Jen as a partner? Anything beyond beyond
  friends/family?

  - Yes? Give up Mav. Explore solo-polyam with Jen. **SoloPoly.**

  - No? Is Mav ok with casual dating?

    - Yes? Keep going. **Dating.**

    - No? **Solo.**

- I have to decide on Jen before any more moves with Mav. If Mav
  decides she is ok casual dating, and I later decide I want more with
  Jen, it will hurt her even more. Right now, I'm letting Mav's
  interest in me dictate what I want with Jen. That's not fair to
  anyone.

What principles can I bring to this decision about Jen?

- Love is abundant. Love as much as I can.

- Compassion for myself. When in conflict with how others love me,
  love myself first and most.

Is Mav or Jen's love for me in conflict with how I would love myself?

- Mav needs to not ask me to save her. Mav needs to not ask me to be
  tied to a continuous routine of obligation. If we switched places. I
  would not stay at her place to feel calm (only if she also wanted me
  there), ask her to text me throughout the day (I would just keep
  saying I love it when she does), I would spend more effort
  protecting myself, would stay away when having a hard time to not be
  a burden, to be positive. I can see she tried to do this, but I
  invited her to share more, to lean on me more. I can see why it is
  confusing to her. Instead of asking for these needs, I said "I have
  a need for autonomy and don't want to do these self-sacrifice things
  that would be expected in a partnership". I could have been clearer
  and more direct. But I basically got there and if she can't respond
  well to me saying what I said, then she's just not a good lover for
  me... she's placing her own needs above my own.

- Jen needs to make her own money and show more love for me.

All this is the midst of heroic coding for Infinite Chat.

Ok.

I DID tell you I needed time apart to do that, and it's been very helpful. I can see you think your email prompted my response, but I had already been preparing to write to you when I received it.

I was surprised by the tone of your message — not because I don’t understand where it comes from, but because, after last summer, I thought we were past needing to relate to each other that way.

I'm also surprised that there’s no acknowledgment of how you handled our divorce. You rejected therapy, and listening to me, and a plan to separate thoughtfully, instead of forcing me be the bad guy with our kids and kicking me out, and so many other things. The coffee shop moment with [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) and [@Paul](person:0b085c55-5431-4cd4-89d1-af1bf1b5e817) was also really hard — for all of us. Your greeting felt disconnected from what was happening and put them in a confusing position. I'm not saying any of this to rehash things, but suggesting you handled everything perfectly is kindof a non-starter. None of that is to say I don't know I've been awful.

I hear that you're not open to discussing the past relationship, and I'll respect that. But, for what it's worth, I have, indeed, worked very hard and dilligently on my anger towards you these past months; I've had terrible resentment built up over our marriage and how it ended and having time apart to work on it was necessary and helpful. I DO still have hope for a friendship, or at least mutual acceptance and understanding. I never decided to end it. I can see that you may have worked through more of it earlier, and I understand your resentment in not being met in kind. I understand if you feel like I didn't meet you the way you needed, when you needed it, and that you don't want that now--or don't trust me.

Where I really want to meet you now is around family. I also want a functional, peaceful, steady relationship there. I want [@Fiona](person:40f1bbfa-f375-4a65-84d9-1290fd02a3c7) and [@Sinead](person:72a05873-c2c7-4de6-b5e2-ae6c2abcf2d3) to feel ease and safety with both of us in shared spaces. If it's okay with you, I'd like to let things cool off a bit and then reconnect next week. I'd like to discuss what a good familial relationship looks like. I want to talk about Fiona's show, and graduation, and we can talk about helping with the yard expenses and other things then.

title: Dream of old house
body:
A repeated dream.

Living in a house. Lots of people, families. On this one, girls, lots of
girls (I think boyfriends?) Watching a movie, I decide I don't want to
watch the movie (Am ignored?)

So I go to my room, which I think is downstairs, there are many rooms...
it's an old big shitty house. Kind of fun, kind of scary. I remember
(from previous dreams) that there are some unfinished parts so I go to
check them out. I open one door that I haven't opened before and am
terrified to find it is unfinished. I find a door that creaked open in a
hallway with broken sheetrock and paneling ceiling collapsing and poke
through the door and hear voices and spy on a black mother and child
then the father... they are hiding, living in the collapsing room. I
back out so they don't see me, but then reconsider and decide to invite
them in to find a nicer room to live in... to be roommates (part of me
knows this is a dream, so why not?)

But as I return, I see another door and curiously open it to see...
horrified... that it is open to the outside... house wreckage
everywhere... rats and feral animals everywhere. I consider for a moment
how I'm going to fix this, shoving at a rat (through glass??) and
considering its size and filthiness. I decide to just close the door for
now. I see a long hallway and walk down it... it opens up and continues
on until I realize I am no longer in the same house, but in a mechanics
shop of sorts... various workers in their cubicle spaces, dark, murmurs.
I try to hide at first, but then, trying to sort things out, I explore,
not willing to be seen. I follow a worker in a jumpsuit and, passing
glances and mumbled phrases, I understand I'm not supposed to be there,
but they're not supposed to be there either.

As I return to find my hallway, I understand, I must build some walls in
my basement to keep them out.

title: Talking to kids about Santa
body:
Told the girls today at dinner that Santa and the tooth fairy don't
exist. I talked to them about stories and asked them whether they like
fiction or non-fiction better and how even if you don't believe the
story it is fun to read. They were totally getting into this part of the
conversation. Then I just told them. Their first reaction was disbelief:
"Yes he does", "Whatever", "We don't believe you". Then some
questions, "So you put the money under our pillows?", "You eat the
carrots?". At one point, I said "We wanted to tell you the story of
Santa when you were little because all parents want their kids to have
that 'Wow! It's magic!!' experience. But we wanted to tell you now
because it can also feel like we're lying." "Because you are!",
[@Fiona](person:40f1bbfa-f375-4a65-84d9-1290fd02a3c7) interrupted. [@Sinead](person:72a05873-c2c7-4de6-b5e2-ae6c2abcf2d3) kept changing the topic and not listening.
Sinead said they had suspicions because they found tags like Santa's in
mom's purse. We kept asking them how they felt about this news and they
said "I don't know." So I told them how I would probably be feeling,
and how I felt when crying my mom into divulging the Tooth Fairy wasn't
real. They both left the table humming Christas songs to themselves. I
told them they were old enough now that I would only ever tell them what
I know to be the truth. I gave [@Fiona](person:40f1bbfa-f375-4a65-84d9-1290fd02a3c7) a long hug.

title: Tue (after Sultan, considering autonomy)
body:
My heart longs for the familiarity of [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c). I like her relative stability
and independence (to [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a)). She has never shown much interest in my
interests, but she has always supported whatever direction I wanted to
go... which I made it easy for her, because I always supported her and
the kids in my directions... and placed her needs above my own.

Mav, on the other hand, admires and desires me, but she is needy. I
didn't think she was needy at first... she was so independent. But she
is entirely needy. She wants someone to be her Darcy.

I'm so independent, I don't know if I want either of them. And yet, I am
drawn to the adventure of Mav and to the calmness of Jen.

Yet Mav isn't really adventurous, is she? Broken back, fear of disease,
fear of being on her own.

And Jen isn't really calm, is she? No job, no health, no kindness or
love.

So, apparently, I want someone who is adventurous, successful,
emotionally stable, happy/kind, physically embodied, present. Someone
who will explore with me or relish my exploration; someone who will
build with me, or encourage my building.

And if I found someone like this... what? We find things in each other's
orbit that we enjoy, and then do it together? Or would I still feel
stifled? What is my ideal relationship? Someone just there to do things
together now and then? To keep the house from being lonely? There has
always been a part of me that wants to be involved in larger groups...
to have work and societies by my focus... to be kind and build and grow
things.

Yes. I want to spend my time building, leading, not romancing. I don't
like romance. I don't like the time it takes to date. I get bored. Like
this weekend in [@Sultan](location:84de30d0-ae79-4e79-bd91-580a67a56ce9)... I felt trapped, suffocated... as though I was
stuck in this other city when I really wanted to just go home and work.
There was nothing to explore, nothing to build. I've felt like this
often, like I don't have time to enjoy the world... but need/want to
keep building.

What would it take for me to calm the fuck down and just enjoy the
world? Explore intentionally. Build at a slow, intentional pace...
something just for me, from my own vision, without the stress of
success, but only for legacy? And if I was doing that, would I want Jen
or Mav beside me? Yes, Jen, if she wouldn't consume all my resources and
criticize me and were curious about the world and less unkind. Yes, Mav,
if she would calm down. Neither feel more important than what I want to
accomplish, though... which has no form... just a feeling of delaying
and not pursuing. There is joy in that for me. I am never more satisfied
and proud than after having built something. No amount of fun parties
give me that kind of kick, no amount of fucking.

My life needs to be about my vision, what I want to explore, and what I
want to build. My lovers need to love me for that and encourage me in
it, not take me from it. My relationships, like the SAIS, need to be
founded on exploring and building together.

Can Mav need/want less? I don't think so, but I can give her a chance.
Can Jen provide for herself? I slow myself down for both of them.

Thought experiment: How might I get it to work with Jen? Move back in.
Make the place feel like my own. I need an office. Evenings with
co-builders. She needs to pay her own way and make her own money for
retirement. She needs to support my vision and not consider me to be a
dumb, insensitive male. She needs to not take offence when I don't share
the same passions she does on specific issues.

Why be with her if I'm never fully there? These things would be nice:
food, music, joyful company, society, travel, confidante, comfort,
hearing about their successes. A sense of stability, longevity, legacy.

Maybe what I like. Is that she is the. Mother. Archetype.

This is probably all more about self-worth. Do I believe people will
like me.

Do I actually believe I can do what I want. I'm kinda simple. I want to
build something beautiful. I want to explore and find astonishing things
and people. I want to love a group of people and be loved in return.

People who waste my time with neediness or pettiness keep me from this
joy.

It's actually quite. Interesting as I sit with this... I don't feel a
big need to have a single person to wallow in. I want to wallow in the
world and the cosmos and be joined by others... make love to others, but
be independent and let them be independent... trusting the world is big
and relational.

title: Anxiety and challenge
body:
Challenge. It makes sense it is the theme of so many epic stories that
we all connect with. Glory from overcoming. It's hard to be the rock in
the storm. I'm anxious as hell when challenged. I operate as though my
life, or at least lifestyle is on the line. I stay anxious until I
overcome. Because of this, I avoid challenge. Simultaneously, I have
deep-seated curiosity, a wonder at how things work, a desire to build.
On top of it all, I have a deep antipathy towards power structures;
liberty is in my bones. Anxiety; Engineering; Liberty. A reorientation
towards challenge would significantly shift the others. Or perhaps I
really am best suited in a non-responsible, high-influence role... that
seems to be continually what I drive for. Nah, that doesn't ring true;
but why isn't it enough for me? Because the hero rises to the challenge.
The voice of anxiety in me: part imposter syndrome; part daddy
disappointment issues; part fixed mindset mentality; part ego shame;
survival;

_"The beauty of the impostor syndrome is you vacillate between extreme
egomania and a complete feeling of: 'I'm a fraud! Oh God, they're on to
me! I'm a fraud!' So you just try to ride the egomania when it comes and
enjoy it, and then slide through the idea of fraud." -- [@Tina Fey](person:f7fba11c-2b49-4a48-a796-8a3faf5ebca0)_

\*"I have written eleven books, but each time I think, **'uh oh, they're
going to find out now. I've run a game on everybody, and they're going
to find me out.' " -- [@Maya Angelou](person:40dff6a2-4bb5-40e9-b63b-f9ac0caf50f2)\***

My hunch is the best way to get rid of IS is to rely on first
principles. You don't _have_ to believe in yourself... just believe that
the principles, if followed, will lead to outcomes. This may be part of
the genius of Design Thinking.

For an engineer, this looks like: models, design and planning
techniques, spikes, diving deeper below the surface until you have
mechanical sympathy. For a lead this may look like ... ? For an
executive, this looks like more models; typical tools and reporting
(blech!)

On the other hand, this is simpler: "The fastest way to get over feeling
like a fraud is to genuinely try to help someone else**."**

"Humility is not thinking less of yourself, but thinking of yourself
less" \--[@C.S. Lewis](person:ef081aa4-4944-470a-a352-899e2a7cb7ea)

Probably not. She is too clingy. She doesn't take control in sex. She

"I'd like some conversations about what happened with us, especially now

What happened with us is pretty clear. She didn't meet my needs. Her
spirituality took her down a road of separation. I felt isolated and
resented providing for her. I didn't feel admired, or respected. I told

She gave me a card the other day that says "in the name of love", for me

Re: Mav, I have wondered if the reason I don't want to take on other

She gives me the possibility here of "hey we're just dating, btw"...

Is her brokenness too much for me? Maybe not. Being expected to protect

Who is my perfect relationship? Someone as deep as Jen, but not so

travel without pain and can get through a week and a month without
terror and loathing. Someone who enjoys nature and beauty. Someone who

Someone as successful as Mav or more.

body:
There's so much mythos surrounding working at [@Google](organization:36688ebc-bac0-4b02-94df-5062562056e6). Except from

understand the magic of the iPhone or Android or Search. The Internet
gives them incredible powers they don't understand; actually makes their
lives better. This sense of gratitude for inexpensive life-changing
technologies that you don't understand... it creates a tentative trust;
you want to be able to trust because they give so much. The trust
required, though, is to step into their world; to become part of their
system. First, the browser; next the car; your home. We're changing the
world; join us or be left in the dark ages. Perhaps it is the
Singularity already.

I was here a few years ago; right after I joined the lab; had just
started [@UW](organization:2e5b1a81-7845-4dab-a23f-83c38b0fa986). I hadn't really done much programming by then; primarily
worked on filling in web app templates with database data. At [@NC](organization:8460175c-2e5c-40c1-a982-a99588f83e76) I
worked on interactive web controls\--tiny state machines. But I had yet
to experience any of this:

- static compilation

- ROS

- containerization/virtualization

- AWS

- Go

- channels/asynchronous design

- green thread/posix thread

- AI class; A\*

- iOS; NodeJS;

- Cluster management; cluster theory

- Distributed Systems class

- Systems design (esp. CoreOS, Mesos)

Essentially, I didn't have the core CS skills. I had never read a paper.
I would get confused and gleeful about a recursive tree walk... and
pissy with [@Steve](person:9e29e490-ae19-4f33-8516-2781d48fc539) that he knew it better than me. Damn. I was blind.

Now, I have gone toe-to-toe with the guy who wrote DOS, a VP of [@Paypal](organization:482b11bf-f496-4376-825f-815cffb39a8e),
the writer of [@Napster](organization:c225cc7f-9136-444d-8d0c-5651e9779dc1); I've been made Principal Engineer (more or less)
by two companies. I've been asked to speak at and nailed a national tech
conference. I know how to build systems from scratch. I am an engineer.

As an engineer, I realize there are deep and interesting technical
challenges in every direction you look. I would love for that to be my
day job. I've realized this at [@Ivy](organization:2e776b5e-ba0c-4d51-b282-0c69dbec15e0); I don't want to be a mid-level
manager within an enterprise. I don't want my life to be spent
eliminating wasteful practices in other people; and especially not being
the garbage-man for a team. In other words; I need self-directed (I
design the systems with others) or I need to be left alone\--there needs
to be an engineering career path. All this is probably just to say; I
want to be building a system; something that is effective and
productive. I have no interest in chasing my tale or making a lifestyle
out of oiling a machine. If I can make all my machines operate without
oil; I would. Waste is an optimization task\--optimize; don't maintain.

I was scared out of my mind last time.

This time, I'm nervous.

Last time I felt like a fraud.

This time I feel like we match well.

I generally KNOW how to do all these things. I just have to continually
communicate how I would actually solve something in the real world. Take
it as a real-world task and SOLVE it.

They are looking to see if I can problem solve. And if I can code. They
are less interested if I can do some fancy solution. They just want to
see if I make the trade-offs. Engineering is all about the trade-offs.

title: Walk with Mav
body:
6 mi run.

Sometimes I feel happy. Little [@Paul](person:0b085c55-5431-4cd4-89d1-af1bf1b5e817) feels taken care of, safe. Right
now, I'm reflecting on self-esteem, confidence, and I feel happy. This
tells me it is fear of the unknown that is paralyzing.

I'm healthy. Energetic. Smart. Wealthy enough. Attractive. Funny. Strong
on my own, yet I've felt heartbreak. A deep, rich heart. I'm ready to go
into the world and see what I find. J

---

Walked with [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) and am not sure what's real. These things are true:

- She invited me to get a drink to celebrate her work board meeting
  success.

- She gave me her hurt. I wept in front of her, sometimes on my knees.

- She said she didn't get with [@Phil](person:520138a2-a693-433f-ab2d-0fbe191ece6a) and didn't want to travel with him
  and didn't want him.

- She said she missed telling me about her life.

- She said she is doing well and likes being alone.

- She said other people, like boy [@Jessie](person:7e39e969-49ae-44b0-9d7d-2296c5a975dc), said I was messing her up.

- She held open the possibility of me going to harefest with her.

- She wanted me to invite her to the 5k run.

Wild.

title: Missing Mav
body:
Predictably missing [@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a).

I have no partiers in my life.

There are several mes:

- Party, revel in life me. Needs to drink, dance, feel, fuck.
- Work, try to build something me. Needs focus, teams, leadership.
- Roots and home me. Needs to recover, rest, chat, drink tea, create a
  home.
- Philosophy, decode life me. Needs quiet time, reflection.

When I am each of these I forget the others.

The ones. That need focus and solitude resent the lovers that I embrace
when I want to party and chat. [@Jen](person:79ed28f0-e91e-42aa-99a2-3d50bbaab49c) and Mav don't seem to have these
personalities. They want all... or maybe it's just me who things I have
to give them that.

I seem to be only attracted to depressed women like my mom... Jen, Mav,
Sarah, the slightly crazy, desperate, the one I am compelled to fix, to
fuck.

But maybe I only find these women because they're the ones that smell me
out and I don't think I deserve more.

Can I find a woman that is complete in herself? One that understands the
many me's and embraces them all? Or as an architect of my life can I
find a woman to be home, Jen?, and women to party. Party women need to
be successful, driven, solitary, like me.

Mav was anxious with me. But she did offer to embrace all... and damn
she could party. Jen can't party and rejected my solitary. Mav rejected
my solitary, too... too anxious.

title: Flying back from family trip
body:
Flying back to [@SEA](location:70e0bcd3-97ce-4d4d-8a36-04a7ffee830d) after Lindgren family trip. Their family doesn't
know how to show love for one another. They are all selfish. [@Jacob](person:9dbeee03-b13c-4293-8957-1fb2e42587c1) is
alone and unequipped. They punish their men. We get together just for
the cousins to feel family. But there is no family.

I put my hand on her back. She stepped away.

The only way forard with her is independently. Which works as a monk,
but not as a lover.

We are so obstinate. Doubling down on ignorant ideas rather than admit
we were wrong and allow ourselves to be happy.

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Ignorant | Happy |
| | |
| - Success will come with | - Fit. |
| satisfying a boss. | |
| | - Free time. |

| be valued. | - Outdoors. |
| | |

| | |

| | |
| - One woman. | - Yin and Yang. |
| | |

| | |

Unfortunate truths

- Justice has never been blind.
- The powerful have always ruled.
- Violence is always an option.
- Security is an illusion.

Fortunate truths

- Individuals are free.
- All things change.
- Less is more. You need very little.

title: Aug 6, 2023
body:
[@Mav](person:11bd1888-7d7a-4e9a-885e-5b520d6e707a) teaches me that I can love and let go. The love I feel, make, the
love I receive and the love I give remain with me... I hold it in my
heart. It changes me. It refines what I love, which is a major component
of who I am. It teaches me about myself. I don't need to hold onto them
for this transformation to happen. I carry the best parts of her love
with me... a gift, a blessing.

The best part of Mav was her play. And now, my own playfulness is
magnified. Then her delightful civility, kindness and openness to those
around her... being polite. She softened my edges. She showed me to
seize the day... life changes weren't to be feared, each opens a whole
world of experience, keeps you young. Leap into your desire. Her means
were always so direct. Just do the next thing. Full sail ahead. Women
are delightful. Sex is joyous. Warm nights with friends and lovers are
magical. It's ok to be at a bar with a book alone. It's important to
look and feel sexy and vibrant. Bring lightness of being, it doesn't
mask depth. Surround yourself with things you love.

The love she refused also taught me about myself. Don't escape pain.
Don't hold on so tightly in fear that no evolution of love is possible.
Speak. Don't demand or expect someone else save you. Don't be naive
about the possibility of others changing (her father, her mother, her
sister, her). Apologize, take responsibility. Listen. Pay attention to
your lover's heart. Love yourself. Don't compromise your boundaries.
Don't use alcohol as an escape or a buffer or a fake sense of
happiness.

My boundaries: I will be loved as I deserve. I will be listened to,
seen, and not be conformed to another's fantasy or fear.

...

Counterculture is Zen. But not the escapism kind.
